text:
S: BN sơ sinh nam, 3 ngày tuổi. Mẹ báo lúc sinh có kẹt vai (shoulder dystocia). Bé quấy khóc nhiều khi cử động tay trái.
O/E: SpO2 98% RA. Khám vùng ngực: sưng nhẹ, có tiếng lạo xạo (crepitus) tại xương đòn trái. Không thấy tụ máu lớn hay biến dạng rõ rệt. Cử động cánh tay trái hạn chế do đau.
Ix: X-quang xương đòn: Hình ảnh gãy ngang xương đòn trái, không di lệch đáng kể.
Imp: Gãy xương đòn do chấn thương khi sinh.
Plan: Theo dõi tại nhà. Hướng dẫn mẹ cách bế tránh tác động lên tay trái. Tái khám sau 1 tuần để kiểm tra độ liền xương.

32M. c/o sudden onset high fever, rigors, and R-sided pleuritic chest pain x2 days. Productive cough w/ thick, rusty-colored sputum. 

O/E: T 39.2, BP 118/76, HR 108, RR 22, SpO2 94% RA. 
Chest: Dullness to percussion and bronchial breathing at RLL. Fine crackles on auscultation in RLL. 

Imp: Lobar pneumonia (suspected S. pneumoniae). 

Plan: Chest X-ray, Amoxicillin 1g TDS, paracetamol for fever/pain, review in 48h if no improvement.

S: RN, 5d. Mãe relata eritema e secreção no coto umbilical desde ontem. Sem febre ou prostração.
O: RN ativo, mamando bem. T 36.9ºC. O/E: Eritema e edema periumbilical, sem sinais de celulite extensa. Pequena quantidade de exsudato purulento no coto. Sem sinais de sepse.
Ix: Hemograma (pendente).
A: Onfalite.
P: Limpeza com clorexidina. Iniciar Ampicilina + Gentamicina IV. Monitorizar sinais de alerta e reavaliar amanhã.

C/O: 48M, bright red blood per rectum x2/4 weeks, itching, and perianal discomfort. History of constipation. No abdominal pain or weight loss.

O/E: T 37.0, BP 130/84. Abdomen: soft, non-tender, no organomegaly. Perianal: swelling and tenderness noted; some bright red blood on inspection. No obvious fissure or abscess.

Ix: CBC: Hb 13.5 g/dL.

A: Haemorrhoids.

P: Advised high fibre diet and increased water intake. Oral stool softener (Lactulose) 15ml TDS. Warm sitz baths twice daily. Topical lidocaine ointment. Review in 2 weeks or if bleeding increases.

Doctor: Karibu, Mama. What seems to be the problem today?
Patient: Doctor, jicho langu la kulia limevimba sana kwenye kona ya pua na linauma. It's been like this for three days and there's this thick discharge.
Doctor: Let me take a look. Oh, I see. There is significant redness and swelling near the medial canthus. Is it tender to touch?
Patient: Very tender, na inaonekana kama kuna usaha unatoka hapo kwenye kona ya jicho.
Doctor: Yes, I can see the purulent discharge. I'm going to apply some pressure; does that express more pus?
Patient: Yes, ouch, it hurts when you do that!
Doctor: Sorry about that. Based on the inflammation, the location, and the discharge, this is a dacryocystitis. The nasolacrimal duct is likely blocked and infected.
Patient: Is it serious? Nimeogopa sana.
Doctor: It's manageable. I'll prescribe some oral flucloxacillin for the infection and we'll do warm compresses to help with the drainage. If the swelling spreads to the eyelid or you develop a fever, you must come back immediately, as we'll need to escalate to systemic antibiotics or refer you to ophthalmology. Clear?
Patient: Sawa, nimeelewa. Nitafuata maelekezo.

Doctor: Chào bà, hôm nay có vấn đề gì ạ?
Patient: Bác sĩ ơi, cái tai phải của tôi nó cứ chảy mủ thối ra suốt mấy tháng nay. Nghe cũng kém hẳn đi.
Doctor: Bà có thấy đau tai hay chóng mặt gì không?
Patient: Không đau, chỉ có mủ hôi thôi, tôi cứ phải lấy bông ngoáy tai mỗi ngày.
Doctor: Để tôi kiểm tra xem. (Soi tai: Thấy lỗ thủng ở phần thượng nhĩ (attic), có vảy da trắng, mủ đặc, mùi hôi. Màng nhĩ không thấy phần xương búa, xương đe).
Doctor: Tai bà có tình trạng viêm mủ mãn tính vùng thượng nhĩ, có vẻ đã ăn mòn xương rồi, đây là dạng viêm tai giữa mãn tính vùng thượng nhĩ-hang.
Patient: Nguy hiểm lắm không bác sĩ?
Doctor: Cái này cần phải chụp CT xương thái dương và có khả năng cao là cần phẫu thuật sớm để lấy hết mô bệnh, nếu không sẽ bị biến chứng vào não. Tôi kê đơn thuốc kháng sinh nhỏ tai tạm thời và viết giấy giới thiệu lên tuyến trên khám chuyên khoa Tai Mũi Họng.
Plan: Giới thiệu chuyên khoa TMH tuyến trên. Chụp CT xương thái dương. Ciprofloxacin nhỏ tai x7 ngày. Tái khám ngay nếu đau đầu, chóng mặt hoặc sốt.

Pt c/o new lesion on R forearm, noted x 3/52. No recent travel or trauma. Exam: 1.5cm pigmented, firm nodule with irregular border. Dermoscopy indeterminate. Dx: skin lesion of uncertain nature. Excision biopsy scheduled for next week to r/o malignancy.

42M, telehealth consult. Patient reports persistent fatigue, muscle weakness, and recurrent dizzy spells when standing up, which he attributes to his recent intense exercise regimen. BP 105/65, HR 72 sitting. Mentions recent dietary changes including significant reduction in table salt. Labs reviewed: Serum Na+ 134 mmol/L, K+ 5.6 mmol/L, plasma renin activity high, serum aldosterone low. No history of adrenalectomy or known autoimmune conditions. Clinical picture consistent with hypoaldosteronism. Plan: Advise increased dietary salt intake, discuss potential underlying etiology with endocrinology, and monitor BP. Return in 2 weeks with repeat U&E/creatinine.

Patient 32M, consulte par vidéo. Douleur persistante maxillaire sup. droite depuis 3 semaines. Signale une dent cariée très sensible au chaud/froid. À l'examen visuel (zoom caméra), présence d'une tuméfaction au niveau de la gencive vestibulaire associée à la 16, avec une petite ouverture fistuleuse laissant sourdre un exsudat purulent par intermittence. Pas de fièvre, pas de trismus. Diagnostic : abcès périapical avec trajet fistuleux. Prescrit amoxicilline 500mg x3/j, métronidazole 250mg x3/j pendant 5 jours. Orientation vers le dentiste pour dévitalisation ou extraction d'urgence.

Mgonjwa: 45M, mkulima. Anakuja na malalamiko ya tishu ya nyama kukua kwenye jicho la kulia kwa miezi 6 sasa. Inawasha na kuwa nyekundu hasa akifanya kazi juani. O/: Pterygium ya nasali kwenye jicho la kulia, inakua kuelekea kornea (takribani 2mm). Haivuki mboni. V/A 6/9 OD, 6/6 OS. Hakuna maumivu makali, hakuna discharge. A/: Pterygium OD. P/: Ushauri wa kutumia miwani ya jua (sunglasses) ili kupunguza uvumbi na mwanga mkali. Nimempa matone ya artificial tears 4x daily. Akiona inasonga zaidi au kuleta shida ya kuona, atarudi kwa ajili ya upasuaji (excision).

Doctor: Guten Tag, was führt Sie heute zu uns in die Klinik?
Patient: Guten Tag, Doktor. Ich habe seit ein paar Monaten ein komisches Druckgefühl im Unterbauch. Es ist nicht wirklich ein Schmerz, aber ich fühle mich untenherum irgendwie so voll, besonders wenn ich lange stehe.
Doctor: Verstehe. Haben Sie dabei Probleme beim Wasserlassen oder Stuhlgang? Irgendwelche Schmierblutungen?
Patient: Nein, die Periode ist eigentlich normal. Wasserlassen ist auch in Ordnung, keine Schmerzen dabei.
Doctor: Alles klar. Ich würde mir das gerne einmal kurz ansehen. Können Sie bitte auf die Untersuchungsliege kommen?
Patient: Ja, natürlich.
Doctor: Bei der Tastuntersuchung spüre ich eine deutliche Vorwölbung der vorderen Vaginalwand, die bei Druck verstärkt nach außen drängt. Alles wirkt sehr locker. Keine Anzeichen für eine akute Entzündung oder Verletzung.
Patient: Ist das etwas Schlimmes? Muss ich operiert werden?
Doctor: Es ist eine deutliche Senkung der Beckenbodenstrukturen. Das Gewebe ist einfach etwas nachgiebig geworden, was bei vielen Frauen vorkommt. Ich werde Ihnen Physiotherapie für den Beckenboden verschreiben. Wenn die Beschwerden unter der Gymnastik nicht besser werden, müssen wir weitersehen.
Patient: Alles klar, ich werde die Übungen machen. Danke, Doktor.

Paciente 24a, queixa de piora progressiva da acuidade visual em AO, mais severa à esquerda. À biomicroscopia: adelgaçamento central corneano com aspecto cônico e sinal de Munson positivo. Dx: ceratocone. Conduta: encaminhado ao especialista para topografia de córnea e avaliação de adaptação de lentes rígidas.

58-jähriger Patient, stellt sich vor mit seit 3 Wochen bestehendem Husten, teils trocken, teils mit wenig gelblichem Sputum. Fieber verneint, Nachtschweiß neg. Raucher (15 py), bisher keine Lungen-Vorgeschichte. O/E: Cor/Pul v.o.b., leises Giemen basal beidseits. SpO2 96% in Ruhe. Thorax-Röntgen kurzfristig ambulant geplant zum Ausschluss pulmonaler Prozesse. Vorerst symptomatische Therapie, Wiedervorstellung bei Zunahme der Dyspnoe.

Patient referral: 42M, reporting chronic fatigue, general malaise and difficulty concentrating for past 3 months. Pt states he feels 'exhausted all the time' despite good sleep. No significant psychiatric history but noted signs of low mood. Physical exam: pale conjunctiva noted, HR 88, BP 124/78. CBC ordered today shows low Hb (9.8 g/dL), but etiology not yet clear based on preliminary indices. Have referred for hematology workup to investigate underlying cause of anaemia. Please advise on management plan pending further blood tests.

Caro collega, ti invio in pronto soccorso il Sig. Santos (45 anni), vittima di un infortunio sul lavoro questa mattina (caduta da impalcatura, impatto addominale contro barra metallica). All'esame obiettivo odierno: addome dolente alla palpazione profonda, guarding diffuso, peristalsi ridotta. Vitals: BP 100/60, HR 105, sat 98%. Eseguita FAST in clinica, risulta positiva per versamento in cavo addominale. Sospetto un trauma da impatto. In attesa di eco/TC urgente per chiarire meglio il quadro addominale. Grazie per la gestione.

Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today?
Patient: I've been feeling absolutely dreadful for about a week. It started with a cold, but now I've got this constant, sharp pain in my chest when I breathe in, and I just can't shake this low-grade fever.
Doctor: Any shortness of breath, or are you coughing up anything?
Patient: The cough is dry, mostly. I just feel like I've got no energy, and the chest pain is starting to get on my nerves.
Doctor: Let me have a listen to your chest. Any night sweats or recent travel?
Patient: No, just stuck at home. My husband had a sniffle last week, but nothing like this.
Doctor: Heart sounds normal. I can hear some crackles at the right base on deep inspiration. Let's get your vitals done.
Patient: Is it serious? I really need to get back to work by Monday.
Doctor: BP 128/78, PR 92, Temp 37.9 C, O2 sats 96% on air. Given the duration and the chest pain with those crackles, it looks like an inflammatory process in the lung tissue.
Patient: So, is it an infection? Do I need antibiotics?
Doctor: It's definitely looking like pneumonitis. Given the presentation, I'm going to send you for a chest X-ray to confirm the extent and rule out anything else. For now, keep hydrated and take regular paracetamol for the fever and discomfort.
Patient: Should I stay off work?
Doctor: Yes, rest is important. I'll provide a sick note for the next few days. If you feel more breathless or your temperature spikes, come back or head to A&E.
Plan: CXR requested. Advised rest, paracetamol 1g QDS, increased fluids. Safety netting provided regarding SOB and high fever.

62M, Landwirt, seit 1 Woche Schmerzen, Tränenfluss und Rötung rechtes Auge. Keine Visusverbesserung mit Brille. O/E: Visus R: Handbewegung, L: 6/12. Diffuse Bindehautinjektion rechts, zentrale grau-weißliche, trübe Läsion auf der Hornhaut mit leichter weißer Infiltration, ca. 3mm. Vordere Kammer schwer einsehbar, kein Hypopyon. Patient gibt an, bei der Feldarbeit einen Fremdkörper ins Auge bekommen zu haben. Diagnose: Ulcus corneae rechts. Plan: Start mit Chloramphenicol Augentropfen 0.5% stündlich, Auge abdecken. Rücksprache mit Augenheilkunde-Einheit in der Stadt für Überweisung zur Spaltlampenuntersuchung notwendig.

34M, industrial welder at Jebel Ali site. C/o acute SOB, chest tightness, and hacking dry cough starting 4 hours post-shift yesterday after working in a poorly ventilated confined space with degreasing solvents (TCE). Denies fever/chills. O/E: T 36.8, RR 22, SpO2 93% on RA, HR 105. Chest: B/L diffuse wheeze, no focal crackles. Plan: Salbutamol nebulization x2, O2 2L via nasal cannula, oral prednisolone 40mg. Advise strict adherence to PPE/ventilation protocols. Return if no improvement in 6h.

32M, riferisce dolore sordo all'orecchio dx da circa una settimana, sensazione di orecchio chiuso e ipoacusia lieve. Nega otorrea o febbre. EO: meato uditivo libero, membrana timpanica opaca, retratta, ridotta motilità alla otoscopia pneumatica. Nessun segno di mastoidite. Resto esame obiettivo negativo. V/S: T 36.8, BP 128/82, SatO2 98%. Imp: Otite media. Plan: Paracetamolo 1g TID per 3gg, monitoraggio. Seguire dieta idratata. Ritorno se peggioramento o comparsa di secrezioni.

Doctor: Please have a seat. What brings you to the clinic today?
Patient: Doctor, I have this very painful, red lump on the back of my neck. It started as a small pimple a week ago, but now it's swollen, hot, and throbbing.
Doctor: Any fever or chills? Have you tried squeezing it?
Patient: No fever, but I feel quite unwell. I did try to pop it earlier, but it just hurt more.
Doctor: Let me take a look. Wow, that is quite extensive. It’s a large, indurated, erythematous lesion with multiple pustular points draining purulent material. It's clearly a cluster of furuncles coalescing.
Patient: Is it serious? I work in the warehouse and it’s very painful under my collar.
Doctor: It’s a carbuncle. It’s a significant localized infection, which is why you’re feeling under the weather. I need to drain this properly, get a swab for culture, and start you on aggressive antibiotics.
Patient: Okay, whatever you think is best.
Doctor: Vitals are stable, T 37.8, HR 92. I'll perform an incision and drainage now under local anesthetic, pack it, and prescribe flucloxacillin 500mg QDS for 7 days. Keep it covered and return if you see spreading redness or develop a fever.

48M farmer from outskirts, c/o progressive dyspnoea and non-productive dry cough x 4 months. Symptoms worse while working in the shed with stored grain during the harvest season; feels 'better' when staying away from the farm for a few days. No fever, no night sweats, no wt loss. Smoker 5 pack-years. 
O/E: Temp 37.2, RR 22, SpO2 92% on room air, fine end-inspiratory bibasilar crackles heard. 
Labs: CBC normal, CXR shows faint ground-glass haziness in both lower zones. 
Imp: Farmer's lung (hypersensitivity pneumonitis). 
Plan: Advise strictly on avoiding grain dust exposure/using N95 masks while working. Prednisolone 30mg OD tapered over 4 weeks. Review in 2 weeks for PFTs and repeat SpO2 check. If no improvement, consider referral for HRCT.

Recém-nascido, 12 dias de vida. Mãe relata que após a queda do coto umbilical há 4 dias, a ferida não cicatrizou e apresenta um 'caroço' avermelhado e úmido no umbigo. Nega febre, sangramento ativo ou supuração abundante. Ao exame: coto cicatrizado, presença de tecido de granulação friável, avermelhado na base do umbigo, cerca de 5mm, sem sinais de onfalite (sem eritema periumbilical, sem calor ou secreção purulenta). Bebê ativo, mamando bem. Dx: granuloma umbilical. Conduta: cauterização química com nitrato de prata em consultório. Orientação sobre higiene local e retorno se houver secreção ou piora do eritema.

S: 28F presenting with complaints of a large, painless swelling in the front of her neck for the past 2 years. Denies dysphagia, dyspnoea, or palpitations. No history of heat intolerance or weight loss. Lives in mountainous region in the West.
O: BMI 21. Diffuse, non-tender enlargement of the thyroid gland, soft to firm consistency, no discrete nodules or bruits. No clinical features of thyrotoxicosis or hypothyroidism noted. Pulse 78 bpm, BP 118/74.
Ix: TSH 2.1 mIU/L (normal). 
Imp: Iodine-deficiency-related diffuse goitre. 
Plan: Counselled on use of iodised salt. Discussed monitoring for compressive symptoms. Review in 6 months or sooner if swelling increases.

Bệnh nhân nam, 45 tuổi, đặt lịch tư vấn qua video vì kết quả xét nghiệm máu định kỳ tại bác sĩ gia đình cho thấy số lượng tiểu cầu thấp bất thường. Bệnh nhân không có triệu chứng chảy máu bất thường, không có vết bầm tím dưới da, không chảy máu cam hoặc chảy máu chân răng. Tiền sử không mắc bệnh truyền nhiễm gần đây, không dùng thuốc mới. Khám lâm sàng qua camera không thấy dấu hiệu xuất huyết hay lách to. Đã yêu cầu làm lại công thức máu (CBC) kèm phết máu ngoại vi để đánh giá hình thái. Hiện tại tình trạng ổn định, chưa có chỉ định can thiệp cấp cứu. Hẹn tái khám sau 2 tuần hoặc sớm hơn nếu xuất hiện triệu chứng mới.

ANC: 68M c/o RUQ pain and progressive jaundice x5/7. Denies fever/chills. O/E: T 36.7, scleral icterus +, abdomen soft, tender in RUQ, Murphy sign negative. Labs: T. Bili 8.2 mg/dL, Direct Bili 6.5 mg/dL, ALP 450, AST/ALT mild elev. US: dilated CBD (14mm) with mid-duct filling defect, gallbladder stones present. Imp: Obstructive jaundice secondary to choledocholithiasis. Plan: Admit for ERCP/sphincterotomy, NPO, IV hydration.

7M male brought in by mother c/o raised red rashes on both legs and buttocks x 4/7. Started as small spots, now coalesced, non-blanching and palpable. Patient also complaining of crampy abdominal pain and mild knee joint pain on walking. No fever, no cough. O/E: Alert, active, T 36.7. Skin: Palpable purpura distributed symmetrically over bilateral lower extremities and gluteal region. No active bleeding noted in oral mucosa. Abd: Soft, mild tenderness in periumbilical area, no guarding. Joints: No obvious swelling, but limited range of motion in right knee due to pain. Urinalysis: +1 protein, +1 blood (hematuria). Impression: Henoch-Schonlein purpura presenting with classic triad of rash, arthralgia, and GI symptoms. Plan: Increase oral fluids, close monitoring of urine output and BP. Start Paracetamol 250mg q6h for pain. Advise mother to watch for signs of worsening abdominal pain or blood in stools. F/U in 48 hours for repeat BP and UA.

Pasien wanita 28 thn, post-partum 4 bulan. C/o rambut rontok hebat saat keramas x2/52. Tidak ada area botak setempat (patchy hair loss). Status dermatologis: kulit kepala normal, tidak ada eritema/skuama. Dx: Postpartum telogen effluvium. Edukasi: kondisi self-limiting, akan membaik seiring waktu. Anjurkan suplemen multivitamin dan kontrol kembali jika progresif.

58M፣ በድንገት የደረት ምች እና የልብ መርገፍ ስሜት አለው። ላለፉት 20 ደቂቃዎች በከፍተኛ ፍጥነት ሲመታ ቆይቷል። BP 115/75፣ HR 175። ECG: ሰፊ QRS ኮምፕሌክስ፣ መደበኛ ያልሆነ ምት፣ በየደቂቃው 175 ይላል፣ ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየ (sustained)። ምንም አይነት የደረት ህመም የለም። የልብ ድካም ምልክቶች አይታዩም። Dx: Sustained VT። በአስቸኳይ ወደ ER ተላከ።

S: 6-jähriger Junge, kommt mit Fieber seit 2 Tagen und Schmerzen beim Schlucken. Verweigert Essen und Trinken. Mutter berichtet von Bläschen im Rachen.
O: Kind wirkt matt, leicht dehydriert. Zunge/Gaumen intakt, aber Tonsillen gerötet mit mehreren kleinen vesikulären Läsionen auf dem vorderen Gaumenbogen. Keine Exantheme an Händen oder Füßen. Lungen klar, Abdomen weich.
Ix: Rachenabstrich für Labor nicht verfügbar.
A: Herpangina, klinisch diagnostiziert.
P: Paracetamol-Saft alle 6h bei Fieber/Schmerz. Viel Flüssigkeit (kühles Wasser, Eis), weiche Kost. Hygieneaufklärung: Ansteckungsgefahr bei Geschwistern. Wiedervorstellung bei Trinkverweigerung oder Verschlechterung.

Telehealth consult. 42M presenting with long-standing skin changes on his feet and nails. Patient reports 'crumbly' and discolored nails for months, plus pruritic, macerated skin between the toes. No systemic symptoms, no fever. O/E: Patient uploaded photos showing distal onycholysis and hyperkeratosis of the nail plate, alongside interdigital maceration and scaling. Clinically consistent with a fungal infection of the skin and nails. Plan: Advised foot hygiene, keeping areas dry. Started Terbinafine cream topically BID. Discussed oral options if topical fails, but will monitor first. Provided sick note for 3 days due to discomfort.

42F farmer, presents with intense itchy right ear x 1 week. Reports feeling of fullness and muffled hearing. No fever or pain. O/E: Right external auditory canal shows fluffy white and black debris covering the canal wall. TM difficult to visualize due to dense fungal mats. No discharge or pinna tenderness. Impression: Otomycosis. Plan: Cleaned canal debris, instilled topical clotrimazole drops. Advised to keep ear dry and avoid cotton buds. Review in 1 week if no improvement.

Doctor: Selamat pagi, Pak Budi. Apa yang bisa saya bantu hari ini?

Patient: Pagi, Dok. Saya butuh surat keterangan sehat untuk melamar pekerjaan di perusahaan logistik.

Doctor: Baik, apakah ada keluhan kesehatan saat ini? Pernah punya riwayat penyakit berat atau sedang dalam pengobatan rutin?

Patient: Tidak ada, Dok. Saya merasa sehat-sehat saja, hanya sesekali pegal karena banyak duduk.

Doctor: Oke, saya akan lakukan pemeriksaan fisik singkat ya. Bisa berdiri di timbangan?

Patient: Baik, Dok.

Doctor: Berat badan 75kg, tinggi 175cm. Tekanan darah 120/80 mmHg, nadi 72 kali per menit. Jantung dan paru-paru bersih. Tidak ada kelainan.

Patient: Bagaimana, Dok? Apakah sehat?

Doctor: Hasil pemeriksaan fisik Anda dalam batas normal, tidak ada tanda-tanda penyakit yang menghambat aktivitas kerja. Saya akan buatkan surat keterangannya.

Patient: Terima kasih banyak, Dokter.

Doctor: Sama-sama. Pastikan tetap jaga pola makan dan olahraga rutin ya.

S: 45y M c/o intermittent epigastric pain and early satiety x 6/12. Reports bloating after meals, no vomiting or hematemesis. No significant weight loss. 

O: BMI 22. Epigastrium soft, non-tender to palpation. No masses or guarding. Bowel sounds normal. 

Ix: Abdominal ultrasound done today showed a thick rim of pancreatic tissue encircling the second part of the duodenum, causing mild narrowing. No biliary dilation.

A: Incidental finding of pancreatic tissue encircling duodenum. Likely congenital.

P: Reassured patient re: findings. Advised on small, frequent meals to manage satiety. To return if symptoms worsen or if obstruction suspected. Reviewed conservative management.

Bệnh nhân nam, 58t, đến khám tại UC theo lịch hẹn để lấy toa thuốc định kỳ. S: Bệnh nhân hiện dùng Metformin 850mg ngày 2v và Lisinopril 10mg ngày 1v. Không than phiền gì thêm, không đau ngực, không chóng mặt, không sụt cân. Đã hết thuốc từ hôm qua. O: Mạch 78 l/ph, HA 135/85 mmHg. Tim đều, phổi trong. Đã kiểm tra toa thuốc cũ trên hệ thống, xác nhận liều dùng ổn định. A: Tái khám định kỳ, ổn định, cần cấp toa thuốc mới. P: Cấp đơn thuốc duy trì Metformin và Lisinopril cho 3 tháng tới. Dặn bệnh nhân tái khám nếu có triệu chứng bất thường.

28F, 6wks post-partum. Patient calling via video visit today. Concerns regarding low milk supply. Reports feeling like she isn't producing enough to satisfy the baby, leading to increased demand for formula supplementation. Denies symptoms of mastitis (no fever, no breast pain or focal erythema). Exam: Pt appears tired, no overt signs of infection. Pt is exclusively pumping and has been skipping night sessions due to exhaustion. Plan: Discussed milk supply maintenance, frequent pumping/nursing, and hydration. Recommended lactation consultant referral for support. Advised on latch techniques if transition to breastfeeding attempted. Follow up if concerns persist or if signs of infection develop.

S: Pria 35 thn, mengeluh gatal hebat dan nyeri pada telinga kanan sejak 1 minggu lalu. Pasien sering berenang di kolam umum. Tidak ada riwayat trauma, tidak ada keluar cairan. Sering mengorek telinga dengan cotton bud. O: Liad otoskopi: kanal telinga eksternal tampak kemerahan dengan massa hifa putih keabu-abuan seperti kapas (cotton-like debris) menutupi kulit kanal. Membran timpani sulit dinilai, tidak perforasi. Nyeri tekan tragus (+). Dx: Otomikosis telinga kanan. P: Pembersihan debris (aural toilet) dengan kuret tumpul, aplikasikan klotrimazol tetes telinga 1% 3 tetes 2x sehari selama 7 hari. Edukasi untuk tidak mengorek telinga dan menjaga telinga tetap kering saat mandi.

S: 28F, married. c/o severe pain upon intercourse since starting a new relationship 6 months ago. Previously sexually active with long-term partner without discomfort. Describes the pain as a burning/tearing sensation localized to the vaginal introitus occurring immediately upon penetration. Denies pelvic inflammatory symptoms, abnormal discharge, or dysuria. 

O/E: General physical exam unremarkable. Pelvic exam: localized tenderness at the 6 o'clock position of the introitus. No signs of infection, atrophy, or pelvic floor hypertonicity. Speculum exam deferred due to severe discomfort. 

Ix: HVS for microscopy and culture requested to rule out secondary infection. 

A: Sexual pain-penetration disorder. 

P: Counsel on nature of condition. Discuss use of water-based lubricants. Refer for pelvic floor physical therapy and psychosexual counseling. Schedule follow-up after results of HVS.

6M male infant brought by mother for worsening pallor and jaundice over the last 3 days. Child had an episode of dark 'cola-colored' urine yesterday. No history of fever, cough, or vomiting. FHx significant for a cousin who had 'blood problems' after taking certain herbal medicines. O/E: Patient is alert but visibly pale and icteric. SpO2 98% RA. Abd soft, liver 2cm below costal margin, spleen palpable 1cm. No rashes. Hb 6.2g/dL. Blood film requested to rule out G6PD deficiency suspected given the classic trigger of fava bean ingestion reported by the grandmother yesterday. Plan: Admit for transfusion if Hb drops further or shows respiratory distress. Send G6PD screen, LFTs, and reticulocyte count. Avoid oxidative drugs.

28F, G3P2, 24/40 gestation. C/o difficulty with urination and recurrent UTI symptoms. O/E: pelvic exam reveals scarring and narrowing of the introitus consistent with FGM Type 2a (infibulation). Plan: counseling on obstetric implications, routine ANC monitoring, urine MCS, continue iron/folate.

45 yaşında erkek hasta, 3 aydır devam eden genel halsizlik, yorgunluk ve egzersizle artan nefes darlığı şikayetleriyle aradı. Bilinen kronik inflamatuar durum öyküsü var. Fizik muayenesinde konjonktivalarda belirgin solukluk mevcut, kardiyovasküler sistem doğal, oskültasyonda raller yok. Vital bulgular: TA 120/80 mmHg, Nb 88/dk, SPO2 %97. Hemogramda Hb 8.9 g/dL, MCV 82 fL (normositik). Laboratuvar sonuçlarında kronik hastalık anemisi ile uyumlu bulgular izlendi. Demir parametreleri ileri tetkik için istendi. Mevcut kronik hastalık zemininde gelişen anemi olarak değerlendirildi. Hastaya temel yaşam tarzı önerilerinde bulunuldu, tedavi planı için kan sonuçları sonrası tekrar görüşülecek.

Doktor: Hoş geldiniz, şikayetiniz nedir?
Hasta: Hocam ellerimdeki uyuşma gece uyutmuyor. Özellikle sağ elim daha kötü, sanki karıncalanıyor gibi.
Doktor: Ne zamandır var bu?
Hasta: Birkaç aydır var, gün içinde iş yaparken artıyor ama gece uykudan uyandıracak kadar çok.
Doktor: Peki, parmaklarınızda güçsüzlük hissediyor musunuz? Düşürme, tutamama gibi?
Hasta: Evet, bazen çay bardağını tutarken zorlanıyorum, bazen elimden kayıyor.
Doktor: Anladım. Bir muayene edelim. El bileğinizi şöyle bir test edelim.
[Muayene: Phalen testi pozitif, sağ elde tenar atrofi hafif mevcut, median sinir dağılımında duyu kaybı izlendi.]
Doktor: Anladım, el bileğinizde sinir sıkışmanız var. Bu yüzden uyuşma ve güç kaybı yaşıyorsunuz.
Hasta: Ameliyat mı olmam lazım?
Doktor: Şimdilik el bilekliği kullanacağız, gece takmanızı istiyorum. Ağrı kesici ve B12 takviyesi başlayalım.
Hasta: Tamam hocam, teşekkürler.
Doktor: İyileşme olmazsa veya güç kaybı ilerlerse mutlaka tekrar gelin.

19M student brought by brother, c/o 6/12 history of constant 'sniffing' glue from plastic bottles. Reports needing to do it every few hours to feel normal, otherwise gets restless and irritable. Admits he cannot stop despite dropping out of school and family conflict. No history of IV drugs or alcohol. O/E: thin male, appears disheveled. Conjunctival injection noted. Chest clear, abdomen soft, no organomegaly. No acute withdrawal signs today. BP 118/74, HR 88. Plan: Counseling on toxic effects of solvent abuse, referred to psychiatric nurse for long-term dependence support and group therapy. Advised on hazards of chronic inhalant exposure. Advised to return weekly for monitoring.

28F, G2P1, 38/40 gestation. Presenting today for routine antenatal checkup. Patient reporting reduced fetal movements since this morning. States 'mtoto hajacheza vizuri leo'. O/E: BP 128/82, P 88. Abdomen soft, fundal height 36cm, FHR 135 bpm. Bedside US shows normal amniotic fluid index. Advised mom to monitor kick counts strictly and return immediately if persistent decrease. Discussed delivery plan as she is nearing term. Imp: Fetus affected by maternal complications of pregnancy. Plan: NST now to ensure reassuring status, then follow up at ANC clinic in 1 week if no further issues.

S: Pz, 28 anni, primipara (26 sett. gestazione). Riferisce dolore addominale acuto insorto dopo sforzo fisico (sollevamento sacchi di mais al mercato) stamattina. Riferisce movimenti fetali presenti. Nega perdite ematiche vaginali o rottura acque.

O: Parametri stabili: PA 115/75, FC 84. Addome teso, dolore alla palpazione profonda in sede peri-ombelicale. Utero non contratto. BCF 140 bpm, ritmo regolare. Cervice chiusa all'esplorazione, non segni di travaglio.

Ix: FHR auscultato ok. Test stick urine negativo per nitriti/leucociti.

A: Stiramento muscolare addominale da sforzo. Nessun segno di distacco di placenta o minaccia di parto pretermine.

P: Riposo assoluto domiciliare per 48h. Paracetamolo al bisogno per dolore. Educazione su evitamento carichi pesanti in gravidanza. Segnali di allarme discussi (dolore persistente, sanguinamento, contrazioni).

Enfant de 6 ans, amené par sa mère pour une consultation de routine après notification scolaire qu'un camarade de classe a été testé positif pour une maladie contagieuse. Pas de symptômes rapportés par la mère : pas de fièvre, pas de toux, pas de diarrhées. Examen clinique : T 36.8°C, gorge propre, pas d'adénopathie cervicale, auscultation cardiaque et pulmonaire normale. État général satisfaisant. Plan : Pas d'intervention nécessaire pour l'instant. Observation à domicile par les parents. Conseils donnés sur les signes d'alerte (fièvre, éruption cutanée, vomissements). Revoir si symptômes apparaissent.

45M c/o unpleasant crawling/creeping sensations in calves & feet worsening in the evenings whilst trying to relax on sofa. Disturbs sleep onset; relief on walking around the room. O/E: neuro exam unremarkable, no signs of iron deficiency anaemia. Dx restless legs syndrome. Advised on sleep hygiene, trial of magnesium supplementation, review in 4/52 if no improvement.

68M consult via video regarding increasing frequency of nocturia and weak stream. Reports waking up 4-5 times per night for the past 6 months. Admits to hesitancy and terminal dribbling. No dysuria, no gross hematuria, no fever. No history of DM or recent UTI. On exam (self-reported): abdomen soft, non-tender. Digital exam not possible via telehealth, but history highly suggestive of BPH. Prostate-specific antigen (PSA) requested at local lab; DRE deferred to next in-person visit. Advised on fluid restriction after 19:00. Started Tamsulosin 0.4mg daily at bedtime. Monitor for orthostatic hypotension. FU in 4 weeks to evaluate symptom relief.

42F farmer, c/o painful swelling on the left side of the neck for 5 days. Noticed it after having a fever and sore throat. No history of TB contact, no weight loss or night sweats. Currently taking Panadol. 

O/E: Alert, temp 37.8C, BP 120/80. Visible swelling in left submandibular area, tender to palpation, approx 3cm, feels firm but mobile. No redness of the overlying skin. Throat red but no exudate. Heart sounds normal, no murmurs. 

Dx: Localised swelling of neck nodes.

Plan: Start Amoxicillin 500mg TDS for 7/7. Advised to continue Panadol for pain and follow up if swelling increases in size or fever persists past 3 days.

Pt, 45F, presented with increasing confusion and dizziness over the last two weeks. Fam says she is 'talking out of head' and has trouble balancing when walking. No history of trauma or known fever. O/E: Patient alert but disoriented to time. Gait unsteady, broad-based. Pupils reactive, no meningeal signs. BP 130/85, HR 88. RBS 5.4. Neurological exam reveals non-specific deficits without clear focal weakness or sensory loss. Plan: Refer to regional hospital for further investigation of CNS symptoms. Started on hydration, keep under observation until ambulance arrives.

8M male, brought by mother c/o passage of 'cola-coloured' urine x24h. History of eating fufu with bean soup yesterday evening. No fever, no vomiting, no abdominal pain. O/E: Pale, icteric sclerae, heart rate 110 bpm. Spleen not palpable. Urinalysis: Blood 3+, protein negative. PBS showing bite cells and blister cells. G6PD screen positive. Plan: Monitor urine output, keep well-hydrated, encourage bed rest. Advise parents to strictly avoid fava beans and traditional herbal concoctions/mentholated products. Schedule follow-up for repeat PCV in 3 days.

24 yaş, G1P0, 10 haftalık gebe. Son 2 haftadır şiddetli bulantı ve kusma şikayeti ile başvurdu. Günde 5-6 kez kusuyor, ağızdan alımı kısıtlı. Kilo kaybı mevcut, halsizlik tanımlıyor. O/E: Tansiyon 100/60, nabız 88. Mukozalar hafif kuru. İdrar tetkikinde keton 2+ pozitif. Gözle görülür dehidratasyon bulgusu yok. Dx: Hafif hiperemezis gravidarum. Plan: Diyet düzenlemesi, B6 vitamini ve metoklopramid 10mg ağızdan başlandı. Oral hidrasyon önerildi. Kilo takibi yapılacak, şikayetler artarsa tekrar başvuru istendi.

S: 32M, charpentier, se présente en consultation volontaire. Rapport sexuel non protégé avec une partenaire occasionnelle il y a 3 semaines. Inquiet concernant un risque potentiel d'infection. Asymptomatique, pas de dysurie, pas d'écoulement urétral, pas d'ulcération génitale. Pas d'antécédents médicaux notables.

O: Patient en bon état général, pas de fièvre. Examen cutanéo-muqueux sans particularité, pas de signes de dermatose. Examen génital : pas d'écoulement, testicules en place, pas d'adénopathie inguinale.

Ix: Test de dépistage VIH rapide et sérologie syphilis demandés (conseil pré-test effectué).

Plan: Counseling complet sur la réduction des risques et le préservatif. Dépistage VIH/IST. Demander au patient de revenir pour les résultats dans 2 jours. Orientation vers le centre de conseil et dépistage anonyme si résultat positif.

S: Пациент 58 лет, поступил с жалобами на одышку при нагрузке, сухой кашель в течение 3 месяцев и периодические боли в груди. Отмечает стойкую заложенность носа с кровянистыми корочками и потерю веса на 5 кг. Отрицает лихорадку.

O: АД 135/85, ЧСС 82, ЧД 18. При аускультации легких — ослабленное дыхание в нижних отделах, хрипов нет. На рентгене ОГК: инфильтраты в верхней доле справа.

Ix: АНЦА (c-ANCA) сильно положительные (титр 1:1280). Креатинин 145 мкмоль/л (повышен), протеинурия 0.8 г/сут. КТ пазух: деструкция носовой перегородки.

A: Гранулематоз с полиангиитом с поражением верхних дыхательных путей и почек.

P: Назначена пульс-терапия метилпреднизолоном 500 мг №3 с переходом на таблетированный преднизолон 60 мг/сут. Подключение ритуксимаба. Контроль креатинина и общего анализа мочи в динамике. Консультация нефролога.

12M boy brought by mother with 4-day history of purple spots on the legs and bleeding from the gums. No fever, no abdominal pain, no history of trauma. Mother reports he completed a course of Co-trimoxazole for a skin infection one week ago. O/E: Child alert, not pale. Multiple petechiae and ecchymoses on bilateral shins and forearms. No lymphadenopathy. Abdomen soft, no hepatosplenomegaly. FBC shows isolated thrombocytopenia (Platelets 12,000); Hb 11.8, WBC 6.2. Peripheral film shows no blasts. Impression: Secondary thrombocytopenic purpura, likely drug-induced. Plan: Stop all current medications, especially any potential triggers. Admit to ward for observation, monitor for signs of internal bleeding. Start oral Prednisolone 1mg/kg/day and review CBC daily.

Mgonjwa mume wa miaka 28, c/o kutokwa na majimaji meupe ukeni (urethral discharge) x3/7, maumivu wakati wa kukojoa. Exam: discharge nyeupe ya utando, hakuna vidonda. Dx: urethral discharge. Plan: Doxycycline 100mg BID x7/7 na Azithromycin 1g stat. Ushauri: aje na mwenza kwa matibabu.

24M, c/o sudden neck twisting and jaw clenching x1/7, started shortly after taking metoclopramide for persistent nausea. O/E: Involuntary sustained contraction of SCM and masseters, no fever, GCS 15/15. Dx: Acute dystonic reaction to antiemetic. Plan: Shift to domperidone, IV diphenhydramine 25mg STAT, refer if symptoms recur.

S: 4-month-old female brought by mother for evaluation of a large, dark skin lesion on the back. Present since birth. Mother reports the area seems to have grown proportionally with the child and notes some hair growth within the patch. No bleeding, ulceration, or pruritus. Child is thriving, exclusive breastfeeding.
O: Alert infant, well-nourished. O/E: Large, hyperpigmented, brown-to-black plaque measuring approx 12cm x 9cm covering the mid-to-lower back, extending slightly over the buttocks. Surface is slightly irregular with fine terminal hairs. No satellite nodules palpated. No neurological deficits.
Imp: Giant congenital melanocytic naevus.
Plan: Explained the nature of the lesion to the mother. Advised regular monitoring for any colour change, nodularity, or rapid growth. Referred to paediatric dermatologist for baseline assessment and discussion regarding long-term management and aesthetic considerations.

S: 34M presents with 5-day history of fatigue, malaise, and mild right upper quadrant discomfort. Reports dark urine and pale stools starting yesterday. Denies fever, travel, or sick contacts. Admits to recent ingestion of raw shellfish. No prior liver disease history.

O: Alert, mildly jaundiced sclera. Abdomen soft, non-tender, no hepatosplenomegaly. T 98.4, BP 122/78, HR 82.

Ix: POC LFTs show ALT 840, AST 620, Total Bili 3.2. Hep panel ordered, results pending.

A: Viral hepatitis.

P: Supportive care, maintain hydration. Advised on strict hand hygiene. Follow up in 48 hours for panel review. Return immediately if intractable vomiting, confusion, or worsening abdominal pain.

24F, G2P1, 16/40 gestation. Attending for routine ANC. C/o palpitations, severe sleep disturbance, and persistent ‘racing thoughts’ starting 2 weeks ago after she began taking illicit ‘speed’ (methamphetamine) from a street vendor to ‘boost energy’. Denies prior psych history. No hallucinations or suicidal ideation. 

O/E: BP 142/92, HR 118, T 36.6. Fundus size corresponds to dates. FHR 146 bpm. Patient appears anxious, tremulous, and restless.

Ix: Urinalysis: no protein. Urine tox: positive for amphetamines. 

Imp: Methamphetamine-induced anxiety in pregnancy. 

Plan: Explain risks to fetus and potential for pregnancy complications. Advise immediate cessation. Counseling on substance use provided. Refer to social worker for support. BP monitoring at home. Review in 1/52 to reassess anxiety levels.

45M, complains of intermittent epigastric burning and bloating over the past 3 months. No weight loss, no melena. Drinks 2-3 cups of coffee daily, smokes 5 cigs/day. O/E: Mild epigastric tenderness on deep palpation, no guarding. Bowel sounds normal. Labs from last week show normal Hb, CRP 2, LFTs normal. Imp: Gastroduodenal distress, etiology unclear. Plan: Prescribed PPI trial (Pantoprazol 20mg OD) for 4 weeks. Advised lifestyle changes (smoking cessation, coffee reduction). If no improvement, will schedule an OGD to investigate further.

مريضة 34 عاماً، راجعت العيادة اليوم بشكوى من تعب عام، خمول مستمر، وشحوب في الملتحمة منذ حوالي شهرين. لا توجد قصة نزف هضمي أو طمث غزير غير معتاد. العلامات الحيوية مستقرة (BP 115/75, HR 78). الفحص السريري: شحوب واضح في الأغشية المخاطية، لا تضخم في الطحال أو الكبد. تم طلب فحوصات مخبرية كاملة (CBC, Ferritin, Iron profile). النتائج أظهرت نقصاً في الهيموغلوبين (Hb 9.8 g/dL) مع مؤشرات كريات صغيرة ونقص في مخزون الحديد. التشخيص: فقر دم بنقص الحديد. الخطة: وصف مكملات الحديد (Tardyferon) مع المتابعة بعد شهر لتقييم الاستجابة.

Paciente, 68 anos, relata palpitações intermitentes e dispneia aos esforços leves há cerca de 3 semanas. Nega dor torácica ou síncope. Ao exame hoje: pulso irregularmente irregular, 112 bpm. PA 138/86 mmHg. Ausculta cardíaca sem sopros audíveis. ECG realizado na unidade demonstra ausência de ondas P e intervalo R-R irregular, confirmando fibrilação atrial. Relata ser o primeiro episódio documentado. Paciente não faz uso de medicações contínuas. Plano: Iniciar Bisoprolol 2,5mg ao dia para controle de frequência. Solicitei exames de função tireoidiana (TSH/T4L) e eletrólitos. Encaminhado para ecocardiograma transtorácico. Orientado quanto ao risco tromboembólico; iniciado protocolo de anticoagulação após cálculo de score CHA2DS2-VASc.

G2P1, 28周妊娠，因头晕、乏力及尿色深来诊。患者自诉昨日进食蚕豆后出现上述症状。体格检查：结膜苍白，巩膜轻度黄染。实验室检查：Hb 7.2 g/dL，外周血涂片见咬细胞（bite cells）及水泡细胞。血清胆红素升高，以间接胆红素为主。G6PD酶活性测定结果显示缺乏。初步诊断为G6PD缺乏症引起的急性溶血性贫血。建议：立即补充叶酸，密切监测胎心及Hb水平，嘱咐患者及其家属后续避免摄入蚕豆及相关氧化性药物。

Bệnh nhân nam, 32 tuổi, tiền sử rối loạn lo âu đang theo dõi tại phòng khám. Gần đây than phiền hay mệt mỏi, uể oải, mất tập trung trong công việc, hay quên. Ngủ chập chờn. Không sụt cân, không sốt. Khám: niêm mạc mắt hơi nhạt, tim đều, phổi trong. BN có chế độ ăn chay trường không kiểm soát chặt chẽ. Đã chỉ định làm công thức máu và bộ xét nghiệm vi chất. Chẩn đoán sơ bộ: Thiếu hụt vi khoáng chất chưa xác định rõ nguyên nhân. Kế hoạch: chờ kết quả xét nghiệm, tư vấn cải thiện chế độ dinh dưỡng, tiếp tục duy trì thuốc hỗ trợ tâm thần hiện tại. Tái khám sau 2 tuần.

S: Paciente de 45 años, acude a revisión refiriendo bajo estado de ánimo persistente, anhedonia y astenia marcada desde hace 3 meses. Niega ideación autolítica actual. Refiere antecedentes de dos episodios similares hace 5 y 8 años, con buena respuesta a ISRS. O: Paciente orientado, colaborador, lenguaje fluido, sin alteraciones sensoperceptivas. Disminución de la psicomotricidad, afecto aplanado, discurso pesimista. Vitals: TA 125/80, FC 78, peso estable. Ix: Escala Hamilton-D: 19 (moderada). P: Diagnóstico compatible con trastorno depresivo recurrente. Mantendremos abordaje farmacológico con sertralina 100mg/día e iniciamos psicoterapia cognitivo-conductual semanal. Cita en 4 semanas para valorar respuesta. Se insiste en mantener hábitos de sueño y ejercicio.

S: Pcte masculino, 34a, relata trauma contuso em membro inferior direito após queda de escada há 2h. Queixa-se de dor intensa, edema local e incapacidade de deambulação. Nega perda de consciência ou déficits neurológicos.

O: Pcte lúcido, orientado. MV presente, sem ruídos adventícios. Abdome flácido, indolor. Membro inferior direito com edema importante e dor à palpação, sem deformidade grosseira ou crepitação óbvia. Pulsos periféricos presentes e simétricos. Sensibilidade preservada.

Ix: Rx de perna e pé sem sinais evidentes de fratura aguda no momento. 

P: Analgesia com dipirona 1g EV. Repouso, gelo local e elevação do membro. Orientado a retornar caso dor piore ou surjam sinais de alarme. Encaminhado para acompanhamento ambulatorial para reavaliação em 48h caso dor persista.

42F, presents with increasing redness and swelling on the right cheek noticed over the last 24 hours. Pt reports feeling feverish and chills since last night. Denies trauma or recent insect bites, but reports a small nick while shaving two days ago. Vitals: T 38.4C, BP 124/82, HR 98. Exam: Clearly demarcated, tender, erythematous, indurated plaque across the right malar region extending toward the bridge of the nose. Borders are slightly raised. No fluctuance noted. ENT exam negative for sinusitis. Plan: Clinical diagnosis of facial erysipelas. Starting cephalexin 500mg QID for 7 days. Advised warm compresses and return if high fever, severe headache, or vision changes occur.
24岁男学生，c/o近日因期末考试压力大，在校内与室友冲突频繁，入睡困难x2/52。无精神病性症状。O/E：神清，语速偏快，余无异常。Dx：学业环境适应不良。Plan：建议调整学习作息，联系校心理咨询中心，必要时随诊。

Doctor: Karibu. Sasa unaeleza nini kinakusumbua leo?
Patient: Daktari, sikio langu la kulia limekuwa likinisumbua sana tangu juzi. Nahisi kama limeziba, na maumivu yanakuja na kuondoka.
Doctor: Je, kuna majimaji yoyote yanatoka sikioni? Homa au mafua?
Patient: Hapana majimaji, lakini naona kama nasikia vibaya upande huo. Homa kidogo ilikuwepo jana usiku.
Doctor: Sawa, hebu nikuangalie. [Kutumia otoscope] Sikio la kulia linaonekana kujaa, kuna wekundu kidogo ndani ya sikio.
Patient: Je, ni kitu gani hicho? Inabidi ninywe dawa za nguvu?
Doctor: Kwa sasa nimeona dalili za uvimbe ndani ya sikio la kati, lakini siwezi kusema ni aina gani hususa kwa sasa. Hali hii inaonyesha shida ya sikio la kati.
Patient: Inatibika haraka? Nateseka na maumivu.
Doctor: Tutaanza na dawa za kutuliza maumivu na tutafuatilia. Ikiwa haitaisha baada ya siku tatu, tutaongeza hatua nyingine.
Patient: Asante daktari.

45M c/o persistent gritty eyes and discomfort, worse in mornings, for past 3/12. Tried OTC drops with no benefit. No vision change, no discharge. 

O/E: Lid margins show scurf and plugged Meibomian glands bilaterally. Conjunctivae mildly injected, no follicles. Cornea clear. TBUT reduced. 

A: Meibomian gland dysfunction.

P: Start warm compresses 10 mins BD, lid hygiene with baby shampoo/lid wipes, and Systane lubricant drops QDS PRN. Advised on omega-3 supplements. Review in 4/52 if no improvement.

المريضة تبلغ ٦٨ عاماً، تعاني من تعب عام وخمول منذ ٣ أشهر. تشتكي أيضاً من تنميل (tingling) في أطراف الأصابع مع صعوبة خفيفة في المشي. الفحص السريري أظهر لسان أملس (smooth tongue) مع انخفاض طفيف في الإحساس بالاهتزاز في الكاحلين. نتائج تحاليل الدم أظهرت فقر دم ضخم الأرومات (macrocytic anaemia) مع مستوى B12 منخفض جداً (85 ng/L). لا توجد مؤشرات على مشاكل امتصاص معوية، والتحاليل تشير إلى غياب العامل الداخلي (Intrinsic Factor). التشخيص: فقر الدم الخبيث. الخطة: بدء حقن هيدروكسوكوبالامين (Hydroxocobalamin) 1mg عضل، المتابعة بعد أسبوعين للتحقق من استجابة الشبكية (reticulocyte response).

68M, carpintero. C/o debilidad progresiva en ambas piernas y hormigueo en los pies desde hace 6 meses. Refiere dificultad para abotonarse la camisa últimamente. Niega dolor lumbar, fiebre o pérdida de peso. Hx de DM tipo 2 mal controlada. O/E: marcha estable pero con lentitud, hipoestesia distal en guante y calcetín, reflejos patelares disminuidos bilateralmente, no hay atrofia muscular marcada. Fuerza 4/5 en ambos grupos distales. Ix: RBS 11.2, HbA1c 8.4%, Creat 105. Hemograma normal. Imp: Polineuropatía distal simétrica de etiología probable metabólica. Plan: Optimizar control glucémico, iniciar amitriptilina 10mg nocte para parestesias, derivación a endocrino y cuidado de pies. Seguir con plan dietético. Cita en 4 semanas.

Nouveau-né, 2 semaines, amené par la mère pour une tuméfaction scrotale vide et inquiétude. Pas de pleurs excessifs, alimentation au sein OK, poids stable.
O/E: Nouveau-né actif, coloration rose. Examen abdominal normal. Scrotum gauche bien développé, mais scrotum droit vide à la palpation. Pas de testicule palpable dans le canal inguinal. Pas de hernie inguinale évidente.
Imp: Cryptorchidie, à surveiller.
Plan: Conseillé un suivi à 6 mois. Si toujours non palpable, besoin d'une échographie pelvienne et référence chez le chirurgien pédiatrique pour évaluation ultérieure. Rassurer la maman sur l'absence d'urgence immédiate.

Doctor: Good morning, please have a seat. What brings you to the clinic today?
Patient: Doctor, I've been feeling this pressure in my chest when I'm working on the site. It started a few days ago.
Doctor: How long does the sensation last, and is it sharp or heavy?
Patient: It's like a heavy weight, maybe five minutes at a time. It goes away when I stop and sit for a while.
Doctor: Any radiation to your jaw or down the arm? Do you get short of breath?
Patient: No pain elsewhere. Maybe a little winded, but the pressure is the main thing.
Doctor: Any history of smoking or high blood pressure? How about family history?
Patient: I smoke a pack a day. My father had some heart issues back home, but I never checked my own pressure.
Doctor: Let's check your vitals now. BP is 155/95, pulse 88, O2 sat 98%. Heart sounds regular, no obvious murmurs, lungs clear.
Patient: Is it serious? I can't really afford to miss days at the site.
Doctor: Your blood pressure is high today. Given your description of the chest tightness during exertion, I'm concerned about your heart. Imp: acute ischaemic heart disease. Plan: Need to rule out active cardiac issues. Sending you for an urgent ECG and troponin level. Starting aspirin 81mg daily and amlodipine 5mg for the BP. No heavy lifting until we have these results back.

S: 28yo G2P1 at 24wks GA. Complaining of 'dhundhla dikhna' (blurred vision) when reading or sewing for the past 2 weeks. Denies headache, flashes, floaters, or eye pain. No history of DM. 

O: BP 115/75, urine dipstick negative for protein. Visual acuity (Snellen) 6/12 OU, improved to 6/6 with pinhole testing. Anterior segment exam normal, pupils reactive, fundoscopy shows no hypertensive changes or retinal pathology.

A: Patient presenting with blurred vision, likely due to change in refraction secondary to pregnancy. No signs of pre-eclampsia.

P: Reassured patient. Advised to visit local optometry clinic for formal refraction check if persistent. Continue routine ANC follow-up.

Paciente, recém-nascido de 3 semanas, trazido pelos pais devido a uma tumoração azulada e indolor no canto interno do olho direito, notada logo após o nascimento. Sem sinais de inflamação, secreção ou febre. Ao exame via vídeo, observa-se uma massa cística firme abaixo do ligamento palpebral medial, compatível com dacriocistocele congênita. Sem sinais de dacriocistite aguda. Orientado massagens hidrostáticas (técnica de Crigler) e encaminhamento para oftalmopediatria caso não resolva nas próximas 2 semanas.

视频问诊。患者，男，34岁，今日上午在工地搬运重物时由于脚下不稳导致身体扭转，感到身体多个部位受力不适，尤其是不确定具体哪个关节部位，自述全身多处酸痛且活动受限。否认明确骨折感，无肢体麻木或剧烈锐痛。查体（视频）：患者神志清，呼吸平稳，双上肢及背部外观未见畸形或皮下瘀斑，触痛范围模糊。BP 135/85 mmHg，P 88 bpm。鉴于目前体检无法确定具体损伤部位，建议休息并观察。Plan：建议休息2-3天，服用Ibuprofen 400mg tid止痛，若出现局部严重肿胀或疼痛加剧请立即前往急诊室复诊。告知如症状不缓解或出现感觉异常需进行放射学检查。

Doctor: Bonjour, Mme Nabwire. Qu'est-ce qui vous amène aujourd'hui au centre de santé ?
Patient: Docteur, ça me brûle terriblement quand je vais aux toilettes depuis deux jours. J'ai aussi l'impression de devoir y aller tout le temps, mais à la fin, il ne sort presque rien.
Doctor: Avez-vous de la fièvre ou des douleurs dans le bas du dos ?
Patient: Non, juste ces brûlures et une gêne au niveau du bas-ventre.
Doctor: D'accord, je vais vous examiner rapidement. Allongez-vous sur la table. Votre ventre est souple, pas de douleur à la palpation profonde des reins.
Patient: C'est grave ?
Doctor: Pour l'instant, ça ressemble à une infection urinaire classique. Je vais demander une bandelette urinaire pour confirmer.
Patient: Est-ce qu'il faut faire une analyse de sang ?
Doctor: Pas pour le moment, les signes cliniques sont assez clairs. La bandelette montre des leucocytes et des nitrites positifs. On va traiter ça tout de suite pour éviter que l'infection ne remonte.
Patient: Qu'est-ce que je dois prendre ?
Doctor: Je vous prescris de l'amoxicilline pour 5 jours et du paracétamol si la gêne persiste. Buvez beaucoup d'eau, c'est très important. Si vous commencez à avoir de la fièvre ou si les douleurs deviennent fortes dans le dos, revenez me voir immédiatement.
Patient: Merci beaucoup, Docteur. Je vais bien boire de l'eau.
Doctor: C'est ça. Prenez bien le traitement jusqu'au bout, même si les symptômes disparaissent plus tôt.

Teleconsultation: 54M, patient calling from Lyon. Complaining of persistent epigastric discomfort and intermittent bloating for the past 6 weeks. Denies recent weight loss, hematemesis, or melena. Currently on PPIs as needed, but reports inadequate relief. PMH: unremarkable. Social: nonsmoker, drinks wine socially. O/E: Patient looks well, abdomen soft, non-tender on palpation today via video. No signs of acute abdomen or jaundice. Impression: Digestive symptoms currently non-specific. Plan: Need to rule out underlying pathology. Requested blood work including FBC, LFTs, and CRP. Arranged for gastroscopy at the local clinic to investigate symptoms further. Advised diet modification and continued PPI; follow up in 2 weeks with investigation results.

Paciente, 42F, dermatologista via teleconsulta. Queixa-se de aparecimento súbito de petéquias disseminadas em MMII e equimoses no tronco após início de uso recente de AAS (aspirina) e um novo suplemento fitoterápico para circulação. Nega sangramento gengival ou epistaxe. Sem febre ou sintomas B. O: Exame físico via vídeo mostra petéquias não palpáveis em MMII bilateralmente. Estabilidade hemodinâmica, ausência de esplenomegalia palpável. Ix: Hemograma completo solicitado revela plaquetopenia isolada (38.000/mm³), com Hb e leucócitos dentro da normalidade. Coagulação normal (TP/TTPA). Hipótese: Trombocitopenia induzida por fármacos. Conduta: Suspensão imediata de AAS e fitoterápico. Encaminhamento para hematologia para acompanhamento da normalização da contagem plaquetária. Retorno em 7 dias com novo hemograma.

مريض ذكر 45 سنة، يراجعنا بـ cough و productive sputum من 4 أيام. لا توجد حمى، لا يوجد ألم صدري حاد، و الـ lung sounds صافية عند الفحص. الـ O2 sat 98% على هواء الغرفة. لا يوجد تاريخ ربو أو مشاكل مزمنة. Dx: bronchitis. تم وصف راحة، سوائل، و OTC cough suppressants عند الحاجة. المتابعة في حال ساءت الأعراض أو استمرت أكثر من أسبوعين.

S: Paziente pediatrico di 14 mesi condotto per ritardo nella deambulazione. La madre riferisce che il bimbo non sta ancora in piedi da solo. Allattamento prolungato esclusivo, scarsa esposizione solare, scarsa assunzione di alimenti fortificati.
O: Peso 9kg (sotto il 3° perc.), irritabilità, bozze frontali prominenti, allargamento delle epifisi ai polsi (segno del braccialetto), rosario rachitico toracico, ipotonia muscolare diffusa.
Ix: Calcio sierico 8.2 mg/dL (basso-normale), fosfatasi alcalina 850 U/L (elevata), fosforo 3.1 mg/dL. Rx polso: sfilacciamento e concavità della metafisi radiale.
A: Rachitismo nutrizionale (deficit vitamina D).
P: Vitamina D3 (colecalciferolo) 2000 UI/die per 3 mesi. Supplementazione di calcio orale. Educazione materna su dieta bilanciata e importanza dell'esposizione alla luce solare. Follow-up tra 4 settimane per controllo clinico e ripetizione ALP.

Mfanyakazi wa ujenzi anaelalamika maumivu ya bega la kulia kwa wiki tatu sasa. Anasema imekuwa ngumu kunyanyua mikono juu au kufanya kazi za kuta. Kwenye uchunguzi, bega ni gumu (stiff) sana, 'active' na 'passive range of motion' imepungua kwa kiasi kikubwa kwenye mzunguko (external rotation). Hakuna historia ya ajali au kuanguka. Hali hii inamzuia kufanya kazi zake za kawaida ofisini na saiti. Nimemshauri mazoezi ya physiotherapy na kupunguza kazi nzito. Nimempa diclofenac gel kwa maumivu.

32M, manual worker at site, c/o R ankle pain after tripping over cables while carrying load 2/7 ago. Difficulty bearing weight initially, now able to limp. No bruising, no clear deformity. O/E: Mild edema lateral aspect, tenderness over lateral ligaments, no bony tenderness on palpation of malleoli. ROM limited by pain on inversion. Neurovascular status intact. Plan: RICE, Ibuprofen 400mg TDS prn, advise light duties x1/52. FU if no improvement.

48M, 已知高血压患者，规律服用Amlodipine。主诉右侧第一跖趾关节剧烈疼痛、肿胀3天，严重影响行走，疼痛于夜间加重。既往无类似发作。查体：右足第一跖趾关节红肿明显，皮温升高，触痛剧烈（+++）。体温37.2度。实验室检查：血尿酸 580 umol/L。结合体征考虑为尿酸盐晶体沉积所致的急性炎症，局部可见皮下痛风石痕迹。诊断：痛风性关节炎。计划：立即给予Colchicine 0.5mg BID，依托考昔 60mg QD止痛；嘱多饮水，饮食调整（低嘌呤），建议行关节腔穿刺以明确诊断，若症状未缓解请尽快复诊。

2-day-old male newborn, born via NVD at PHC, birth weight 3.2kg. Referred from local midwife due to right arm inactivity since delivery. O/E: Right arm held in adducted, internally rotated position with elbow extended and forearm pronated (waiter's tip deformity). Moro reflex absent on the right side; grasp reflex intact. No clavicular crepitus or bony tenderness detected. Plan: Physical therapy referral for gentle range of motion exercises to prevent contractures, follow-up in OPD in 2 weeks to monitor for spontaneous recovery of Erb paralysis. Ensure mother understands positioning to avoid pressure on the affected limb.

Consultation vidéo avec patient M. Schmidt (54 ans). Suivi pour douleurs épigastriques persistantes apparues il y a 3 semaines, irradiant vers le dos. Contexte : patient traité par AINS (Ibuprofène 600mg, 2x/j) depuis plus d'un mois pour une lombalgie chronique sévère. Pas de signes d'alarme (dysphagie, vomissements, perte de poids). Examen clinique : abdomen souple, sensibilité marquée à la palpation profonde de l'épigastre, pas de défense. Pas de Méléna. Le patient rapporte que la douleur est calmée par la prise alimentaire puis réapparaît 2-3h après. Décision : suspicion forte d'ulcération duodénale induite par les AINS. Arrêt immédiat de l'Ibuprofène, relais par Paracétamol. Prescription d'un IPP (Pantoprazole 40mg/j) en cure de 8 semaines. Demande de gastroscopie pour confirmation diagnostique et recherche H. pylori. RV à prévoir après résultats endoscopiques.

مريض عمره 34 عاماً، يشتكي من رجفة (tremor) في اليد اليمنى منذ حوالي شهرين. المريض يلاحظ أن الرجفة تزيد عند مراقبة الآخرين له أو عندما يكون متوتراً، وتتحسن بشكل ملحوظ عند تشتيت انتباهه أو أداء مهام بسيطة. لا يوجد تاريخ مرضي عصبي سابق. في الفحص السريري عبر الفيديو، لا يوجد بطء حركي (bradykinesia) أو تصلب (rigidity). الرجفة تظهر خصائص غير ثابتة (inconsistent) وتتغير تردداتها عند الاختبار. الفحص العصبي العام طبيعي. الانطباع السريري: رعاش وظيفي. الخطة: طمأنة المريض، البدء بجلسات العلاج السلوكي المعرفي (CBT)، وإحالة لعيادة الأعصاب للتقييم المتخصص لاستبعاد أي تداخلات أخرى.

Paciente, 68M, empleado administrativo (expats), traído a consulta virtual por su hija debido a cambios cognitivos progresivos reportados en los últimos 12 meses. La familia refiere olvidos frecuentes de citas, desorientación ocasional en lugares conocidos y dificultad para seguir conversaciones complejas. No hay antecedentes conocidos de ACV, trauma craneal o consumo de sustancias. Se quejan de apatía y pérdida de iniciativa en actividades previas (idiomas, lectura). O/E: Paciente alerta, orientado en persona pero desorientado en tiempo. MMSE realizado de forma remota sugiere deterioro cognitivo moderado. Lenguaje fluido, sin afasia evidente. Piden evaluación adicional para descartar patología degenerativa. Plan: Solicitar analítica básica (B12, TSH, electrolitos) y derivar a neurología para evaluación neuropsicológica completa y neuroimagen. Instrucciones dadas a la familia sobre seguridad en el hogar y supervisión.

S: 34M, construction worker. Presents complaining of generalized fatigue, intermittent muscle weakness, and unexplained weight fluctuations over the last 3 months. Denies heat/cold intolerance or tremors. No polyuria or polydipsia.

O: BP 128/82, HR 78, BMI 24.5. Thyroid non-palpable. Heart sounds normal. No peripheral oedema. Neurological exam: intact cranial nerves, reflexes 2+ globally, no focal deficits.

Ix: FBC, U&E, LFT, HbA1c, TSH, morning cortisol ordered to screen for underlying metabolic or endocrine dysregulation.

A: Patient presenting with vague, non-specific constitutional symptoms suggestive of potential endocrine dysfunction. Needs investigation to rule out hormonal imbalances.

P: Awaiting blood results. Advised to maintain hydration and follow up in one week for review of labs.

S: 62F, 3/12 süren gözlerde kuruluk, yanma ve kum varmış hissi ile başvurdu. Göz damlası (artificial tears) kullanmış ancak rahatlama sınırlı. Ek hastalık: HT. Sigara yok. Kontak lens kullanmıyor.
O/E: Göz kapakları doğal. Konjonktival hiperemi yok. Slit lamp muayenesinde her iki kornea alt kadranında noktasal epitelyal erozyonlar izlendi. Kornea yüzeyi matlaşmış. Fluorescein boyama ile alt 1/3'lük alanda boyanma pozitif.
Ix: Schirmer testi (anestezi sonrası): 5 mm (sağ), 6 mm (sol) (5 dk).
Imp: Keratoconjunctivitis sicca.
Plan: Preservative-free suni gözyaşı damlası günde 4-6 kez başlandı. Gece kullanımı için jel eklendi. Omega-3 desteği önerildi. Şikayetler devam ederse oftalmolojiye yönlendirilecek.

Doctor: Good afternoon. I'm reviewing your telehealth request regarding the skin rash. Please describe what's happening.
Patient: Doctor, it's my hands. They have been red, itchy, and peeling for about three days. It started right after I spent all afternoon peeling and chopping a large amount of raw chili peppers and garlic for a family dinner.
Doctor: Understood. Any blistering or burning sensation?
Patient: The burning was very intense at first, now it's mostly stinging and dry.
Doctor: Are you using any new soaps or detergents?
Patient: No, nothing new, it was definitely after handling those peppers. I've been trying to keep them hydrated with local coconut oil.
Doctor: Based on the localized distribution strictly on the palmar and interdigital surfaces where you handled the ingredients, and the timing of exposure to the chili capsaicin and garlic juices, this is a clear irritant contact dermatitis. I'm prescribing a short course of topical hydrocortisone 1% cream to manage the inflammation and stinging. Avoid further direct handling of hot peppers without gloves while the skin barrier heals. Keep it clean and continue with your bland moisturizer. If it doesn't improve in 5-7 days, we can schedule an in-person follow-up to rule out secondary infection.

Paciente femenina, 28 años, gesta 3, 24 semanas de embarazo. Refiere dolor y pesadez en miembros inferiores, mayor al final del día. Al examen físico: presencia de venas dilatadas y tortuosas en cara interna de ambos muslos y pantorrillas. No hay signos de trombosis (sin edema asimétrico, sin calor local, homans negativo). Signos vitales: TA 110/70, FC 88. Plan: Uso de medias de compresión, elevar piernas al descansar, evitar estar de pie periodos prolongados. Control en prenatal.

Paziente 45F, viene riferita per dolore e gonfiore marcato all'angolo interno dell'occhio destro da 5 giorni. Riferisce epifora costante e secrezione purulenta che migliora temporaneamente con pulizia. EO: Tumefazione eritematosa e dolente in sede sottocantale nasale dx. Alla digitopressione sulla zona, riscontro reflusso di materiale purulento dal punto lacrimale inferiore. Non febbre sistemica. Occhio dx tranquillo, visus conservato. Imp: Dacryocystitis acuta dx. Plan: Iniziato amoxicillina/clavulanato 875/125mg 1cp x2/die x 7gg, impacchi caldi. Istruita a non premere ulteriormente la tumefazione. Ritorno in caso di febbre o aumento dell'eritema.

4 aylık erkek hasta, annesi tarafından son 2 haftadır fark edilen, ağladığında belirginleşen, göbek deliği çevresinde şişlik şikayetiyle getirildi. Kusma veya dışkılama sorunu tariflenmiyor. Fizik muayenede: Genel durumu iyi, canlı, aktif. Batın rahat, barsak sesleri doğal. Umblikal bölgede, ıkınma ile belirginleşen, yumuşak, redükte edilebilir yaklaşık 1.5 cm'lik kitle izlendi. T 36.6, nabız 128, solunum 32. Plan: Aileye şişliğin takibi ve redükte edilemediği veya ağrının eşlik ettiği durumlarda acile başvurmaları konusunda eğitim verildi. Cerrahi poliklinik kontrolü önerildi.

Doctor: Good morning. What brings you to the emergency department today?
Patient: I feel terrible, doctor. I've been extremely thirsty for the last three days, drinking liters of water, and I've been urinating constantly. I feel very weak and my stomach has been hurting since last night.
Doctor: Any vomiting or fever?
Patient: I vomited twice this morning after trying to eat some bread.
Doctor: Are you currently diagnosed with any medical conditions?
Patient: Yes, type 1 diabetes, but I ran out of my insulin two days ago.
Doctor: Let's get you checked immediately. Your capillary blood glucose is 'HI' on the monitor and urine dipstick shows 4+ ketones and large glucose. Your breath has a slight fruity odor.
Patient: Is it serious? I just feel so exhausted.
Doctor: Your pulse is elevated at 112 bpm, and your blood pressure is 105/65. You are in diabetic ketoacidosis without coma. We need to start IV fluids and insulin therapy right away to stabilize your pH and electrolyte balance. I am admitting you to the ICU for close monitoring of your blood gases and potassium levels.
Patient: Okay, I understand. Please help me.
Doctor: We will start an insulin drip and aggressive hydration now.

Doktor: Hoş geldiniz, şikayetiniz nedir?
Hasta: Hocam, Dubai'de şantiyede çalışıyorum. Son 4-5 gündür sağ kulağımda bir tıkanıklık ve dolgunluk hissi var, duymakta zorlanıyorum.
Doktor: Ağrınız veya akıntınız oldu mu hiç?
Hasta: Hayır, sadece sürekli bir uğultu ve sanki içeride bir şey varmış gibi tıkanıklık hissi.
Doktor: Yakın zamanda havuza girdiniz mi veya kulağınıza su kaçtı mı?
Hasta: Evet, haftada birkaç kez yüzüyorum, bazen kulağıma su kaçıyor ama hemen çıkıyordu, bu sefer geçmedi.
Doktor: O zaman bir bakalım. Otoskopik muayenede sağ dış kulak yolunda sertleşmiş, koyu renkli kitle görüyorum. Kulak zarı tam seçilemiyor.
Hasta: Nedir o doktor bey?
Doktor: Kulak kiri, yani buşon. Suyla temas edince şişmiş ve kanalı tamamen kapatmış. Bu yüzden duyamıyorsunuz.
Hasta: Peki ne yapmamız lazım?
Doktor: Şimdi nazikçe aspire edeceğim ve küretle temizleyeceğim. Sonrasında rahatlarsınız.
Hasta: Çok iyi olur, gerçekten çok rahatsız ediyor.
Doktor: Temizlik yapıldı, kanal açıldı, zar temiz. Impression: Sağ kulakta tıkayıcı buşon, dış kulak yolu temizlendi. Plan: Kulak hijyeni hakkında bilgilendirildi, yüzme sonrası kurulama önerildi, gerekirse 6 ayda bir kontrol.

S: 7yr m, mtoto analalamika maumivu ya magoti yote mara kwa mara kwa miezi 7. Hakuna homa, hakuna uvimbe wa viungo vingine, hakuna historia ya majeraha. Mama anasema maumivu ni makali asubuhi.
O: Mtoto anaonekana mwenye afya, hakuna dalili za sistemiki. Goti la kulia na kushoto lina uvimbe kidogo, joto la kawaida. Hakuna uwekundu, lakini kuna ugumu wa kupanua miguu asubuhi (stiffness). Viungo vingine vyote viko sawa.
Ix: ESR imepanda kidogo, RF negative.
A: Juvenile idiopathic oligoarthritis (persistent) - viungo vitatu vimeathirika.
Plan: Rufaa kwa mtaalamu wa mifupa ya watoto. Kuanzisha NSAIDs (Ibuprofen) kwa maumivu. Physiotherapy ya mazoezi ya viungo kuzuia contractures. Ushauri kwa wazazi kuhusu ugonjwa huu sugu.

42岁女性，自诉近期极度乏力、脱发及指甲脆弱，伴有轻度情绪低落，持续约3个月。患者平时素食为主，且有慢性胃炎史。查体：BP 110/70 mmHg，BMI 19.5，皮肤粘膜苍白，无震颤，神经系统查体未见异常。既往史：甲状腺功能正常，近期未服用特殊药物。血常规示轻度贫血（Hb 11.2 g/dL），需进一步完善血清微量元素及相关离子水平检测以明确是否存在矿物质缺乏，建议先补充复合矿物质制剂，嘱加强膳食摄入，2周后复诊。

Paciente 45a, sexo feminino, chega ao pronto-socorro referindo 'mancha de sangue' no olho esquerdo que notou ao acordar hoje. Nega trauma ocular, dor ou alteração na acuidade visual. Sem uso de anticoagulantes, nega HAS descompensada. Ao exame: área focal de sangue vivo, bem delimitada sob a conjuntiva bulbar temporal, sem comprometimento da córnea ou câmara anterior. Pupilas isocóricas e fotorreativas. Biomicroscopia sem outras alterações. Diagnóstico: Hemorragia subconjuntival. Conduta: Orientada quanto à benignidade e resolução espontânea. Lavagem com soro fisiológico se desconforto. Retorno se dor ou baixa de visão.

S: Mgonjwa wa kiume, 45, analalamika maumivu ya tumbo sehemu ya juu (epigastric) kwa wiki 3. Maumivu yanapungua akila chakula. Hapana kichefuchefu wala kutapika. Hakuna historia ya matumizi ya NSAIDs. 
O/E: T 36.9, BP 120/80. Epigastric tenderness inayoonekana, tumbo laini. DRE: stuli ya kawaida, hapana damu. 
Ix: H. pylori rapid test: Positive. 
Imp: Duodenal ulcer inayohusiana na H. pylori. 
Plan: Triple therapy: Amoxicillin 1g BD, Clarithromycin 500mg BD, Omeprazole 20mg BD kwa wiki 2. Ushauri wa kubadilisha mtindo wa maisha. Kurudi kliniki baada ya siku 14 kufuatilia maendeleo.

28F, G2P1, 32/40 weeks gestation c/o severe pruritus and blistering on abdomen x 2 weeks. O/E: tense bullae on urticarial plaques near umbilicus. No history of drug reaction. Dx: Gestational pemphigoid. Plan: Refer to Dermatology for biopsy/DIF, start topical clobetasol 0.05% ointment, monitor fetal growth.

Doctor: أهلاً يا سيدي، كيف يمكنني مساعدتك اليوم في فحص العمل الدوري؟
Patient: دكتور، أنا أعمل في الموقع منذ فترة طويلة، لكن من بعد إصابتي بكورونا قبل ٦ أشهر، لا أستطيع إكمال ورديتي. أشعر بتعب شديد وضيق تنفس مع أقل مجهود.
Doctor: هل تعاني من أي أعراض أخرى حالياً؟ سعال، ألم صدر؟
Patient: لا سعال، لكن الذاكرة ليست كما كانت، أشعر بـ 'ضبابية' في عقلي وصداع متكرر يمنعني من التركيز في التقارير.
Doctor: دعنا نفحص العلامات الحيوية. الضغط 125/80، النبض 88، الأكسجين 98% في الراحة.
Patient: نعم، في الراحة أنا بخير، لكن بمجرد الحركة يرتفع النبض بسرعة وأشعر بالإجهاد.
Doctor: هل أجريت أي فحوصات إضافية مؤخراً؟
Patient: نعم، فحصت وظائف الرئة والقلب وكانت سليمة حسب التقرير، لكنني ما زلت لا أستطيع العمل.
Doctor: الفحص السريري للصدر نظيف ولا يوجد علامات قصور قلبي. الواضح أن الأعراض استمرت لأكثر من 3 أشهر بعد الإصابة الأولية بـ COVID-19 ولا يمكن تفسيرها بتشخيص آخر.
Doctor: الانطباع هو حالة طويلة الأمد بعد الإصابة بفيروس كورونا.
Plan: سنقوم بعمل تحاليل دم شاملة لاستبعاد الأنيميا أو نقص الفيتامينات، وسأكتب توصية بتعديل مهام العمل لتكون خفيفة لمدة شهر مع المتابعة في عيادة الطب المهني.

9 yaş erkek hasta, annesi çocuğun son 4 gündür sağ kulağında dolgunluk hissi ve işitmede azalma olduğunu belirtiyor. Anamnezde ağrı veya akıntı tanımlanmıyor. O/E: Sağ dış kulak yolunda büyük, sert ve tamamen kanalı tıkayan cerumen birikimi izlendi, timpanik membran seçilemiyor. Sol kulak normal. Vitals: Ateş 36.8C. Imp: Kulak kiri tıkacı. Plan: Cerumen yumuşatıcı damla (sodium bicarbonate ear drops) 3 gün günde 2 kez damlatılması önerildi, ardından lavaj için kliniğe davet edildi.

S: 4-day-old female, term infant. Neonatal unit admission. Mom reports heavy methadone and heroin use during 3rd trimester. Nursing reports infant is hypertonic, exhibiting high-pitched persistent cry, and poor suck reflex since this morning.

O/E: HR 168 bpm, RR 65/min, Temp 37.6C. Marked tremors of extremities. Moro reflex exaggerated. Skin excoriation noted on knees from excessive rubbing. Stool loose, 4 episodes in 6 hours.

Ix: Urine tox screen positive for opioids. Finnegan score 14.

Imp: Neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome.

Plan: Start morphine sulphate weaning protocol per standard unit guidelines. Maintain caloric intake with frequent feeds. Monitor Finnegan scores q4h. Social work consult for mother.

26F c/o maumivu makali upande wa kulia wa uke x4/7, iko na uvimbe mwekundu unaoleta shida kukaa au kutembea. O/E: T 38.4, eneo la labia majora kuna uvimbe mkubwa, mkali (tender), uliokomaa (fluctuant) na wenye usaha. Dx: Abscess ya Bartholin. Plan: I&D chini ya local anaesthesia, kusafisha na saline, amoxicillin/clavulanate x5/7. Ushauri: usafi wa eneo hilo, review baada ya 48hrs.

Patient is a 52-year-old male, driver by profession, presenting for review of chronic lower limb swelling. Reports that he spends 10-12 hours daily seated in his vehicle, with minimal opportunity for walking or elevating his legs. Physical exam shows bilateral pitting edema (2+) up to the mid-calf. Skin is thickened and hyperpigmented, but no evidence of ulceration, venous stasis dermatitis, or cellulitis. Vascular ultrasound of the legs ruled out DVT. Vitals: BP 138/86 mmHg, HR 78 bpm. Assessment: Oedema secondary to prolonged sedentary position and chronic immobility. Advised to take scheduled breaks every 2 hours to walk and perform calf exercises. Prescribed graduated compression stockings, class II. Review in 1 month to assess compliance and symptomatic improvement.

42M presents today for follow-up of hypertension. Reports increased life stress since layoff last month. Admits to drinking significantly more than usual over the past 4 weeks, consuming ~6-8 beers daily after work to help with sleep and mood. Denies morning shakes, withdrawal seizures, or blackouts, but reports spouse is concerned about his irritability and performance at home. BP today 148/92, pulse 88, weight stable. Exam unremarkable aside from mild scleral injection. Labs: ALT/AST ratio suggestive of alcohol use, GGT elevated. Plan: Discussed harmful pattern of alcohol use. Counseled on reducing intake and provided CAMH resources for outpatient support. Will monitor liver enzymes in 6 weeks and follow up on blood pressure control.

ታካሚው 34 ዓመት ወንድ ነው። ለረጅም ጊዜ በውጭ ጆሮ ቦይ ውስጥ መዘጋጋት ስሜት እና የጆሮ ማሳከክ ቅሬታ ይዞ መጥቷል። በተደጋጋሚ መዋኘት ይለማመዳል። ምርመራ ሲደረግ ሁለቱም የጆሮ ቦይ በቆዳ ቀለም የተሸፈኑ ጠንካራ የአጥንት እድገቶች (bony outgrowths) በቦይ ግድግዳ ላይ ይታያሉ። ታምቡር (TM) በግልጽ አይታይም። የመስማት ችሎታ በትንሹ ቀንሷል። ምርመራው በጆሮ ቦይ ውስጥ የሚታዩ አጥንታዊ እድገቶች ናቸው። ለጊዜው የጆሮ ንጽህና እንዲጠብቅ እና ውሃ እንዳይገባበት መክሬዋለሁ። አስፈላጊ ከሆነ ወደ ENT እንልካለን።

Bệnh nhân nam, 22 tuổi, sinh viên du học tại Barcelona. Khám vì tình trạng luôn cảm thấy buồn ngủ, mệt mỏi vào ban ngày, ảnh hưởng nghiêm trọng đến việc học tập. Khai thác bệnh sử cho thấy bệnh nhân luôn đi ngủ rất muộn (thường sau 2 giờ sáng) và khó thức dậy vào buổi sáng, dù đã cố gắng thay đổi thói quen nhưng không thể ngủ sớm hơn. Khi đã ngủ được thì giấc ngủ ổn định, không ghi nhận các triệu chứng như ngưng thở, ác mộng hay co giật chân. Sức khỏe thể chất bình thường, không sử dụng chất kích thích hay thuốc an thần. Đánh giá giấc ngủ cho thấy sự lệch pha rõ rệt giữa nhịp sinh học cá nhân và yêu cầu của môi trường học tập. Huyết áp 120/80 mmHg, khám lâm sàng không có gì đặc biệt. Hướng dẫn bệnh nhân thực hiện liệu pháp ánh sáng vào buổi sáng và duy trì vệ sinh giấc ngủ nghiêm ngặt, cân nhắc bổ sung Melatonin liều thấp nếu không cải thiện sau 2 tuần.

Thai 22t, thai phụ 20 tuần, đến khám định kỳ. Bệnh nhân có tiền sử chán ăn tâm thần nhiều năm nay, hiện tại BMI 16.5, vẫn duy trì thói quen ăn rất ít và cố gắng nôn sau khi ăn vì sợ tăng cân. Khám lâm sàng: mạch 72 l/p, HA 100/60 mmHg, phù nhẹ hai chi dưới. Siêu âm thai nhi bình thường, kích thước phù hợp tuổi thai. Tư vấn dinh dưỡng cao năng lượng, yêu cầu bổ sung sắt và acid folic. Đã giải thích kỹ về nguy cơ suy dinh dưỡng ảnh hưởng thai nhi. Hẹn tái khám sau 2 tuần để kiểm tra cân nặng và theo dõi sát chỉ số sinh tồn.

Patient seen in clinic today for review of chronic dermatological lesions. Mgonjwa amekuja na vidonda sugu kwenye ngozi ya mikono na kichwani. On examination, linear excoriations and scarring are noted, consistent with habitual hair pulling and skin picking. Patient admits to constant 'kujikuna na kung'oa nywele' especially when anxious. No secondary infection. Vitals stable, BP 120/80. Plan: Advised on habit reversal therapy and referred for psychiatric evaluation to manage underlying body-focused repetitive behaviour. Emollient cream provided for skin comfort.

S: 68M, retired construction worker, presents for evaluation of persistent exertional dyspnea and non-productive cough, worsening over past 6 months. No fevers or weight loss. Former smoker, quit 10 years ago.

O: Vitals stable. Auscultation reveals fine bibasilar inspiratory crackles. Clubbing noted in fingers. Chest X-ray shows bilateral interstitial opacities, predominantly in the lower zones, and thickened pleura.

Ix: HRCT confirms extensive interstitial fibrosis and pleural plaques suggestive of environmental exposure. Spirometry shows restrictive pattern (FVC 65% predicted). Occupational history significant for 30 years of insulation work involving high-exposure to mineral fibres including asbestos.

A: Interstitial lung disease secondary to chronic mineral fibre inhalation.

P: Refer to pneumology for further pulmonary function testing and DLCO. Advise smoking cessation and avoid further irritants. Follow-up in 3 months.

Doctor: Mang Kanor, what brings you in today?
Patient: Doc, it's my stomach. Been bloated for weeks and I feel this crawling sensation, plus I'm passing these string-like things in my stool sometimes.
Doctor: Any fever, vomiting, or blood in your stools?
Patient: No fever, Doc. Just the discomfort and really loose bowels lately.
Doctor: How's your appetite? Have you been losing weight?
Patient: Appetite is okay, but I feel weak. I just want to get rid of whatever is inside.
Doctor: Let's check your vitals. BP is 110/70, Temp 36.8, HR 82. Abdomen is soft, mildly tender in the epigastric area, no organomegaly.
Patient: Is it serious? I heard it could be worms.
Doctor: It's likely a parasite. I'll order a stool exam to confirm, but based on your history, I'm starting you on deworming meds today.
Patient: Can I go back to work tomorrow?
Doctor: Yes, just make sure you wash your hands well before eating and don't walk barefoot in the soil to avoid re-infection. Let's see the lab results next week.

Pz: B.A., 14 mesi, maschio. Madre riferisce da 3 settimane episodi ricorrenti di pianto inconsolabile e irritabilità durante e subito dopo i pasti. Nessun vomito, alvo regolare, no febbre. Madre molto ansiosa, riferisce che il bambino sembra 'soffrire' ma non localizza dolore. EO: addome trattabile, non disteso, no masse palpabili, peristalsi presente. Peso in curva, idratato. Non segni di patologia organica acuta. Imp: sospetto disturbo funzionale digestivo in prima infanzia. Piano: rassicurata la madre, educazione su tecniche di alimentazione. Monitoraggio peso tra 2 settimane. Se persiste, valutare ulteriori accertamenti.

48M c/o persistent daytime sleepiness, fatigue, and reports from wife about heavy snoring and nocturnal gasping. Denies morning headaches, excessive alcohol use, or medication changes. BMI 31.5. O/E: BP 142/90, HR 82. Oropharynx: Mallampati class III, tonsillar hypertrophy absent. Heart: S1/S2 regular, no murmurs. Lungs: clear. Ix: SpO2 96% on room air. Hb 14.2 g/dL. TSH 2.1 mIU/L. Imp: Suspect chronic sleep-disordered breathing. Plan: Refer for polysomnography to rule out underlying nocturnal respiratory events. Advise weight reduction and sleep hygiene optimization. Review post-sleep study.

S: 78Y E.K., bilinen HT ve DM tip 2 hastası. Son 2 haftadır artan nefes darlığı, ortopne ve bacaklarda şişlik şikayetiyle başvurdu. Geceleri 3 yastıkla uyumak zorunda kaldığını belirtiyor.
O: TA 155/95, Nabız 92/dk (ritmik), SS 22/dk, SpO2 %91 oda havasında. Pretibial +2 pitting ödem mevcut. Dinlemekle bilateral bazallerde krepitan raller duyuldu. S1-S2 doğal, ek ses veya üfürüm saptanmadı. Hepatomegali izlenmedi.
Ix: EKG: Sinüs ritmi, sol aks. NT-proBNP yüksek geldi. Akciğer grafisinde belirgin vasküler dolgunluk ve kardiyomegali izlendi.
Imp: Dispne ve ödem tablosu, dekompanse kalp yetmezliği ön planda.
Plan: Furosemid 40mg 1x1 başlandı, tuz kısıtlaması önerildi. PA akciğer grafisi ve eko için randevu verildi. 1 hafta sonra kontrol.

Patient: 12-day-old male neonate. Presentation: Mother reports persistent white patches inside mouth and red, weeping rash in diaper area for 3 days. Breastfeeding normally but appears irritable during feeds. O/E: Oral mucosa shows confluent white plaques, non-scrapable, underlying mucosa erythematous. Groin shows bright red beefy rash with satellite papules and pustules extending into skin folds. T 36.8C. Assessment: Neonatal candidosis (thrush and candidal dermatitis). Plan: Apply nystatin oral suspension 100,000 U/ml (1ml) 4x/daily to oral lesions. Clotrimazole 1% cream to napkin area with every change. Advise boiling of pacifiers/bottles and hygiene for mother's nipples if breastfeeding. Return if spreading or fever.

S: 28M, brought by partner. Reports 2 weeks of extreme, intrusive checking behaviours ('checking locks 50+ times/night'), excessive hand-washing, and inability to leave house due to fear of contamination. Claims this started after 'heavy weekend' using crystal meth. No prior OCD hx. 
O: BP 145/95, HR 102 bpm. Alert but visibly anxious. Excoriation on bilateral hands. No overt psychosis/hallucinations today. UDS positive for amphetamines. 
Ix: UDS sent, ECG unremarkable, TSH/B12 normal. 
A: New onset OCD-like symptoms temporally linked to recent high-intensity methamphetamine use. 
P: Discussed link between stimulant use and obsessional phenomena. Advised complete abstinence. Refer to addiction services. Start sertraline 50mg OD for now. Review in 2 weeks to assess if symptoms persist after withdrawal period.
