S: 62F, presents with a persistent, non-tender lump in the left supraclavicular fossa noted 3 months ago. Initially thought it was a cyst, but reports it has slowly increased in size. No B symptoms: no night sweats, no weight loss, no fevers. No cough or dysphagia.
O: Palpable firm, fixed node, approx 2cm in the left supraclavicular space. No other lymphadenopathy palpated. Abd soft, no hepatosplenomegaly. ENT exam normal.
Ix: Urgent bloods sent: FBC, ESR, LFTs, LDH. Refer for urgent US and biopsy of the mass.
Plan: Advise patient on potential differentials. Will await imaging results before onward secondary care referral. Safety net provided regarding rapid growth or systemic symptoms.

S: 45yo female, receptionist. Anakuja with concerns about her toenails which have looked 'funny' for months. No pain, but she finds it embarrassing. She denies any trauma. Nil known DM or PVD.
O: Examination reveals thickened, yellowish, brittle toenails on the right big toe and second toe. Subungual hyperkeratosis noted. No surrounding inflammation, pus, or warmth.
Ix: Nail clippings taken for fungal culture/microscopy.
A: Onychomycosis, confirming presence of fungal infection causing nail plate deformity.
P: Started on Terbinafine 250mg once daily for 3 months. Advised on foot hygiene: keep feet dry, wear breathable shoes, and change socks daily. Review in 12 weeks to monitor response and check LFTs if needed.

Doctor: Chào chị, hôm nay chị thấy thế nào?
Patient: Bác sĩ ơi, cái khuỷu tay phải của tôi đau quá. Mấy hôm nay tôi cầm nắm đồ hay đánh máy đều đau nhói ở phía ngoài khuỷu.
Doctor: Chị có làm gì khác thường gần đây không, hay có bị va đập gì vào tay không?
Patient: Không va đập gì cả. Tôi làm văn phòng, phải đánh máy liên tục. Mà tuần trước tôi mới tập lại môn tennis, chơi xong là thấy đau ngay.
Doctor: Chị cho tôi kiểm tra nhé. Ấn vào chỗ lồi xương ở mặt ngoài khuỷu tay thì sao ạ?
Patient: Á! Đau thốn lên tận cánh tay.
Doctor: Chị nắm tay lại rồi cố gắng bẻ ngược cổ tay lên chống lại lực đẩy của tôi xem nào.
Patient: Đau quá, không làm được.
Doctor: Vâng, dựa trên triệu chứng và thăm khám, tôi thấy chị bị viêm lồi cầu ngoài xương cánh tay, hay còn gọi là hội chứng khuỷu tay tennis. Phim X-quang hiện tại chưa cần thiết vì bệnh cảnh rất điển hình do quá tải vận động.
Patient: Vậy có nghiêm trọng không bác sĩ? Tôi phải làm gì ạ?
Doctor: Không sao ạ. Tôi sẽ kê cho chị Ibuprofen để giảm viêm và giảm đau. Chị cần hạn chế các động tác xoay cổ tay mạnh, nên dùng băng đeo khuỷu tay và chườm lạnh sau khi vận động. Nếu sau 2 tuần không đỡ thì mình quay lại tái khám để xem xét vật lý trị liệu.

S: 68 y/o male, smoker (20 pack-years). c/o bilateral calf pain when walking > 200m, relieved by standing still for few mins. Symptoms worsening over last 6/12. Denies rest pain, numbness, or skin changes. 

O/E: BP 145/85, HR 78 bpm. BMI 27. Pulses: femoral palpable, popliteal weak bilaterally, pedal pulses absent. No bruits auscultated over abdomen or femoral triangles. Skin warm, no ulceration or trophic changes noted. 

Ix: ABI pending (scheduled next week). Lipid panel and HbA1c ordered. 

Imp: Claudication, likely peripheral arterial disease. 

Plan: Start ASA 81mg OD. Atorvastatin 40mg OD. Strict smoking cessation counselling provided—referred to quit-line. Advise regular walking program. Review post-ABI and labs.

BN 42t, than phiền mất ngủ dai dẳng 6 tháng nay, hay bị cảm giác khó chịu ở chân vào buổi tối khi đang nằm thư giãn, phải cử động chân hoặc đi lại mới thấy dễ chịu. Triệu chứng này làm bệnh nhân khó đi vào giấc ngủ, gây mệt mỏi ban ngày. Khám lâm sàng: HA 120/80, BMI 24. Không có dấu hiệu thần kinh khu trú. Đã loại trừ thiếu sắt qua xét nghiệm máu gần đây (Ferritin bình thường). Chẩn đoán: Hội chứng chân không yên (Restless legs syndrome). Kế hoạch: Dặn vệ sinh giấc ngủ, kê đơn Pramipexole 0.125mg trước ngủ. Hẹn tái khám sau 4 tuần để đánh giá đáp ứng.

Patient: 34M, construction worker. Presenting with sharp pain in the left groin area after a heavy lifting accident on-site yesterday. No history of fall. Denies numbness or tingling in the lower limbs. O/E: Localized tenderness over the left hip adductor/flexor group, no visible bruising or swelling noted. ROM limited due to pain on flexion, no instability or bony crepitus. Impression: Acute strain of the left hip muscle/tendon. Plan: Rest, apply ice pack for 20 mins every 4 hours, and ibuprofen 400mg TID prn pain. Advise modified duty for 1 week. Return if pain persists or if there is difficulty in weight-bearing.

24M, known case of FMF, presented with severe recurring abdominal pain and low-grade fever since yesterday. No history of recent injury or unusual food intake. On exam: abdomen is tender on palpation, guarding present in RLQ, but bowel sounds active. Vitals: T 38.6C, HR 105, BP 124/80. Chest clear, heart sounds normal. Noted a small patch of erythematous rash on the lower leg, typical of his previous episodes. Labs show elevated CRP 85 and WBC 14.5. Given his history and clinical presentation, this is an acute flare of his condition. Plan: Started on colchicine 0.5mg BD, IV fluids for rehydration, and analgesia with paracetamol. Advised follow-up with rheumatology in 1 week. If abdominal pain worsens or persistent vomiting develops, return to ER for surgical consult to rule out acute abdomen.

Doctor: Good morning, Mr. Henderson. What brings you in today? Patient: I'm just so tired all the time because I can't stay asleep. Every night, just as I'm drifting off, my legs start crawling. Doctor: Tell me more about that sensation. Is it painful? Patient: Not really painful, just this intense, creepy-crawly urge to move them. If I get up and walk around, it goes away instantly. Doctor: How long has this been going on? Patient: It's been happening for months, maybe a year now. I've been kicking the sheets off my wife. Doctor: Any history of anemia or low iron levels? Are you taking any new meds? Patient: I've been on the same blood pressure pills for years. No, nothing new. Doctor: Okay, let's check your vitals. BP 138/85, pulse 76, BMI 27. Lung fields clear. I suspect you have Restless Legs Syndrome given the classic urge to move the limbs that improves with activity. I'll order a ferritin test to rule out iron deficiency and we can discuss starting a dopamine agonist if your quality of life continues to suffer. Patient: That makes sense. I just want a good night's sleep. Doctor: I hear you. Let's start with the bloodwork and see where we're at.

45M, driver. c/o persistent cough with yellow-green phlegm x 4/7, low grade fever, and dull chest discomfort. No h/o wheeze or previous asthma. 
O/E: Conscious, oriented. Vitals: BP 120/80, HR 88, Temp 99.8F, RR 20. Chest clear on auscultation, no added sounds or wheeze. Throat slightly erythematous, no exudate. 
Imp: Acute bronchitis. 
Plan: Tab Augmentin 625mg TDS x 5/7, Tab Paracetamol 500mg SOS for fever, Tab Ambroxol TDS. Advised plenty of warm fluids and steam inhalation. Return if SOB or no improvement in 3 days.

42M, c/o shingo la shingo (neck swelling) x6/12, lumpy, growing slowly. No dysphagia, no voice changes, no weight loss. O/E: Neck mass right side, firm, fixed, 4cm, no overt lymphadenopathy. BP 124/80, pulse 78 reg. RBS 5.1. Imp: Neck mass, r/o endocrine malignancy. Plan: FBC, TSH, U/S neck, FNA, refer to surgeon.

32M, manual laborer, c/o right arm pain following a slip and fall at work yesterday. States he landed hard on his outstretched hand. Now reports significant soreness, swelling, and difficulty rotating his forearm. No numbness or tingling in the fingers noted. Denies loss of consciousness or head trauma. O/E: Localized swelling and tenderness noted over the forearm area. Visible bruising, no obvious deformity. ROM limited due to pain, distal pulses intact, capillary refill <2s. Plan: Advised RICE protocol (rest, ice, compression, elevation). Recommended paracetamol 500mg tab every 6 hours as needed for pain. Requested plain film X-ray of the forearm to rule out any underlying fractures. Advised to return immediately if any weakness develops in the hand or if pain becomes unbearable.

42F c/o RUQ pain x4/7 radiating to back, worse after fatty meals. Freq nausea, no vomiting. O/E: Murphy's sign (+), sclerae non-icteric. Abdominal US shows multiple echogenic foci in GB with posterior acoustic shadowing and thickened wall (4mm). Dx: Calculus of gallbladder with acute cholecystitis. Plan: Admit for IV ceftriaxone/metronidazole, analgesia, and referral to district hospital for elective cholecystectomy.

S: Paciente masculino, 24 años. Solicita examen físico completo para completar trámite de licencia de conducir. Refiere estar asintomático, sin antecedentes médicos de relevancia ni consumo de medicamentos actuales. 

O: TA 120/80, FC 72, SatO2 99%. Examen físico: buen estado general, tórax claro, ruidos cardiacos rítmicos, abdomen blando no doloroso. Agudeza visual conservada. 

Ix: N/A. 

P: Se realiza examen físico completo y certificado médico según requisitos para licencia de conducir. Paciente apto para la conducción. Se entrega formulario firmado.

58M, stable, hx of HTN. Calling regarding 4/7 of left lower quadrant abdominal pain, non-radiating, associated with mild fever (38.1 C) and constipation. Denies blood in stool, vomiting, or urinary symptoms. O/E: Abdomen soft but tender to palpation in LLQ, no guarding or rebound. No organomegaly. Bowel sounds present. Pt is hemodynamically stable. Given the localized tenderness and symptom duration, clinical picture is consistent with acute diverticulitis of the sigmoid. Plan: Initiated on oral Augmentin 875mg BID x 7 days and clear fluid diet. Advised strict return precautions for worsening pain, high fever, or inability to tolerate PO. If no improvement in 48h, will need urgent imaging to confirm and rule out complications.

45F c/o RUQ pain post-fatty meal, persistent nausea x24h. O/E: Murphy's sign (+), T 100.8F, P 98. US abdomen shows thickened gallbladder wall at 5mm with 12mm impacted stone in cystic duct. Dx: Acute cholecystitis with cholelithiasis. Plan: Admit for IV antibiotics, surgical consult, and NPO.

42M presents complaining of 'fullness' and intermittent conductive hearing loss in the right ear for the past 2 weeks, exacerbated by swimming. Denies pain, otorrhea, or tinnitus. O/E: Right EAC shows significant narrowing due to multiple smooth, broad-based, bony outgrowths arising from the tympanic annulus. Canal skin is intact and non-inflamed. TM is visualized with some difficulty but appears dull/retracted. Left ear canal and TM unremarkable. Weber/Rinne testing consistent with mild conductive loss on the right. Plan: Advised patient against aggressive cleaning to avoid skin trauma. Referral to ENT for assessment, as these bony projections are causing significant canal occlusion. No topical drops indicated at this time.

Doctor: Hola, cuénteme qué le trae hoy por aquí.
Paciente: Doctor, llevo unos tres días con un dolor muy fuerte en la boca del estómago, como ardor, y náuseas. Siento mucha inflamación.
Doctor: ¿Ha tenido fiebre o vómitos claros?
Paciente: No, solo las náuseas y el dolor constante, sobre todo después de comer.
Doctor: Entiendo. Vamos a revisar. Presión 124/82, pulso 88, temp 36.7. A la palpación abdominal hay dolor localizado en epigastrio, sin defensa ni rebote. Ruidos hidroaéreos presentes.
Paciente: ¿Cree que sea algo grave?
Doctor: Parece una inflamación de la mucosa gástrica. Probablemente gastritis. Vamos a empezar con inhibidores de la bomba de protones y dieta blanda.
Paciente: ¿Algo más?
Doctor: Evite irritantes como el café y el picante por una semana. Si el dolor aumenta o nota sangre en las deposiciones, regrese de inmediato. Impresión diagnóstica: Gastritis agudizada sin signos de alarma.

Doctor: Mama, karibu. How is the pregnancy going? Any complaints today?
Patient: Thank you, Doctor. Everything is fine with the baby, I feel him kicking. But my left ear is really bothering me, I can hardly hear out of it since I went swimming yesterday.
Doctor: Any pain or drainage from the ear?
Patient: No pain, just a feeling of fullness, like it is blocked tight.
Doctor: Let me take a look. Please tilt your head this way.
(Examination: Otoscopy of the left ear reveals the external auditory canal is completely obstructed by a dense, dark brown mass. The tympanic membrane cannot be visualized.)
Doctor: It looks like you have a large plug of wax in there, likely pushed further in when you got water in it yesterday.
Patient: Is it serious? I'm worried it will affect the baby.
Doctor: No, it is not serious, it is just common wax accumulation. I will irrigate it for you now to clear the passage.
Imp: Impacted cerumen, left ear.
Plan: Perform ear syringing with warm saline. Advise against using cotton buds in the future. Follow up if symptoms persist.

42M, construction worker, presented to ED via ambulance following a fall from scaffolding (~2m) at work. Pt describes landing on his right leg with the foot inverted. Intense pain at the right ankle, unable to weight bear. O/E: Right ankle markedly swollen with obvious deformity. Tenderness noted over the lateral malleolus and medial aspect of the joint. No neurovascular compromise, dorsalis pedis pulse 2+. X-ray right ankle shows a fracture of the lateral malleolus at the syndesmosis, associated with a displaced fracture of the medial malleolus and a fracture of the posterior margin of the distal tibia (trimalleolar fracture pattern). Plan: Analgesia administered (Dipirona 1g IV), ankle splinted, ortho consult requested for urgent ORIF. NPO for surgery.
مريض يعاني من أعراض اكتئاب وقلق عام نتيجة تسريحه من العمل منذ 4 أشهر. لا تاريخ مرضي سابق للاكتئاب. Dx: بطالة كسبب للمشكلات النفسية. الخطة: دعم نفسي وتوجيه لخدمات التوظيف المحلية.

42M, farmer. c/o chronic R ear itching, dull ache, and sensation of fullness x3/12. Tried H2O2 drops with minimal relief. Denies discharge, no vertigo or fever.
O/E: R ear canal shows white, fluffy, filamentous growth on otoscopy, obscuring part of TM. TM appears intact, no obvious perforation. Left ear clear.
Imp: Otomycosis (R).
Plan: Gentle aural toilet using warm saline, then instill clotrimazole drops (1%) BD for 14 days. Advise to keep ear dry, avoid cotton buds or digging. RTC in 2 weeks if no improvement.

Paciente masculino, 12 años, traído por madre por dolor abdominal tipo cólico recurrente x 3/52 y episodios de distensión abdominal. Refiere pérdida de apetito y cansancio. No presenta diarrea ni sangre en heces. Al examen físico: abdomen algo distendido, ruidos hidroaéreos presentes, no masas, no organomegalia, sensibilidad difusa leve. T 37.1, FC 88. Imp: Sospecha de infestación parasitaria intestinal. Plan: Solicito examen coprológico completo, Albendazol 400mg dosis única hoy, repetir en 14 días. Recomendar lavado de manos frecuente y hervir agua. Regresar si no mejora o hay dolor intenso.

24F, college student, c/o persistent sneezing, itchy eyes, and watery nasal discharge every morning for past 3 months. Pt says symptoms get way worse when she cleans her room or changes bedsheets. No fever, no sore throat, no sinus pressure. OTC cetirizine helps but only for a few hours. Exam: pale, boggy nasal turbinates noted on video call, clear rhinorrhea. Clear lungs. Assessment: Allergic rhinitis triggered by dust mites. Plan: Avoidance advice given—suggested using anti-dust mite covers for pillows/mattress, frequent vacuuming with HEPA filter. Start Fluticasone nasal spray 2 puffs daily, continue antihistamine PRN. Return if sinus pain or heavy yellow mucus develops.

Doctor: Bonjour Madame, quelle est la raison de votre visite aujourd'hui ?
Patient: Bonjour docteur. Je suis un peu inquiète, j'ai des saignements anormaux depuis quelques mois.
Doctor: D'accord, pouvez-vous m'en dire un peu plus ? Est-ce que ce sont des saignements en dehors de vos règles habituelles ou bien une modification de votre cycle ?
Patient: C'est assez irrégulier. Parfois c'est très léger, parfois plus abondant, et ce n'est jamais aux mêmes dates. C'est très perturbant.
Doctor: Compris. Avez-vous des douleurs abdominales ou pelviennes associées ?
Patient: Non, aucune douleur, juste ces pertes de sang inattendues.
Doctor: Prenez-vous une contraception hormonale ou un autre traitement médicamenteux en ce moment ?
Patient: Non, aucun.
Doctor: Très bien. Je vais procéder à un examen clinique et une palpation abdominale.
(Examen : Abdomen souple, non douloureux. Examen au spéculum : col utérin d'aspect macroscopiquement sain, saignement endo-utérin visualisé, pas de lésion vaginale évidente.)
Doctor: L'examen clinique ne montre rien de particulier sur le col ou le vagin. Il s'agit manifestement de saignements utérins anormaux dont l'origine reste à préciser. Je vais vous prescrire une échographie pelvienne et un bilan biologique complet pour explorer cela plus avant.
Patient: Entendu docteur, merci.

Mgonjwa ni mwanamke, miaka 45, amekuja na malalamiko ya kushindwa kupata usingizi wa kutosha kwa miezi kadhaa sasa. Anasema anapata shida sana kuanza kulala usiku na anashtuka mara kwa mara bila sababu maalum, jambo linalomfanya awe mchovu mchana. BP 120/80, mapigo 78, mapafu safi. Hakuna dalili za wasiwasi au msongo wa mawazo uliokithiri. Tumejaribu ushauri wa kawaida wa usafi wa usingizi lakini hakuna nafuu. Naomba ushauri wako kwa ajili ya usimamizi zaidi.
6岁男童，体重8.5kg，精神萎靡，伴腹泻3天。查体：眼窝凹陷，皮肤弹性差，可见典型的“老头面容”。心肺听诊未见异常，无水肿。当地营养补充计划跟进不到位，家庭经济困难。诊断：急性营养不良。处理：转诊至区医院行强化营养治疗及补液，同时筛查寄生虫病及TB。

Doctor: Good morning, Mrs. Higgins. I see you're back regarding those persistent abdominal symptoms. Any changes since our last visit? Patient: It's just getting worse, Doctor. This dull, heavy ache in my abdomen won't go away, and I feel like my waistband is tighter than it's ever been. Doctor: Have you noticed any unintentional weight loss or changes in bowel habits? Patient: No, just the bloating and the feeling of fullness very quickly when I eat. Doctor: Okay, let's have a look at your abdomen. I see you have some generalized distension. When I press here, it’s quite firm and tender. The ultrasound report from last week showed a large, complex, fatty-appearing mass localized to the retroperitoneum, pushing on the bowel loops. Patient: Is that why it feels so heavy? Is it serious? Doctor: I’m concerned about the nature of this mass. Given the density and the location, we're looking at a liposarcoma of the retroperitoneum. It's a significant finding that requires immediate attention from an oncology surgeon. I'm going to initiate an urgent referral to the tertiary centre for a biopsy and staging. I know this is a lot to process, but we need to move quickly on this.

Telekonsultasi, pasien pria 28 th, keluhan ejakulasi cepat sejak awal aktif secara seksual. Hubungan seksual dengan pasangan tetap selalu berakhir dalam <1 menit penetrasi. Tidak ada masalah ereksi, tidak ada nyeri, dan tidak ada riwayat trauma/infeksi sebelumnya. Pasien cemas dengan performa. O/E: TD 120/80, N 78, BMI 23. Tidak ada kelainan urologis fisik yang ditemukan. Riwayat psikososial stabil. Imp: Ejaculatio praecox lifelong. Rencana: Edukasi teknik stop-start, sarankan penggunaan kondom (desensitisasi), dan latihan dasar panggul. Kontrol 4 minggu lagi untuk evaluasi progres.

S: 42M, non-smoker, c/o persistent non-productive cough x 4 months and progressive exertional dyspnoea. No haemoptysis, fever, or weight loss. Reported mild night sweats but otherwise systemically well. Occupation: electrician.
O: Obs: RR 18, SpO2 96% on room air, HR 72, BP 124/80. Chest: bilateral fine inspiratory crackles at bases. No peripheral lymphadenopathy or rash.
Ix: CXR shows bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy and reticulonodular opacities in upper zones. Spirometry: mild restrictive pattern, FEV1/FVC 82%. HIV and quantiferon gold both negative.
A: Suspected pulmonary sarcoidosis. Likely stage II.
P: Referred for respiratory clinic review and HRCT chest. Advised to monitor for worsening breathlessness. Safety netted for red flags (haemoptysis, night sweats).

5F, c/o persistent, extremely itchy bumps on the lower legs for 3 months. Pt lives in a rural area, plays barefoot on the grass. Mom says they initially look like simple mosquito bites but they persist for weeks as hard, dark, pruritic nodules. No fever, no night sweats. O/E: Multiple hyperpigmented, firm, dome-shaped papules on both calves and ankles. Some show excoriation. No signs of secondary bacterial infection. No active lesions on trunk. Imp: Persistent insect bite reaction. Plan: Calamine lotion applied topically, cetirizine syrup 5ml nightly, emphasized use of footwear outdoors, and keeping sleeping area clean to avoid further bites.

32F, new pt, via telehealth. Pt reporting chronic epigastric pain, early satiety, and episodic emesis over past 6 months. Lost approx 8kg unintentionally. Denies fevers or hematemesis. Initial concern for gastritis, but recent private EGD report obtained: 'dense, matted collection of hair and debris found in gastric body and fundus, forming a cast of the lumen, obstructing pyloric transit.' Pt admits to compulsive hair pulling and chewing (trichotillomania). Vitals today stable (BP 118/76, HR 72, BMI 17.5). Labs show mild microcytic anemia (Hb 10.8). Assessment: Gastric trichobezoar causing partial outlet obstruction. Plan: Refer to GI at Hospital Clínic for endoscopic retrieval/surgical consultation, psychiatric referral for trichotillomania management, and nutritional support started.

Doctor: Good morning, Herr Weber. You mentioned the persistent sinus issues and the numbness in your feet during our last phone check-in. Tell me more about the nasal congestion. Patient: It’s terrible, Doctor. My nose is crusted over, I have frequent nosebleeds, and I feel like I have no air. Plus, my toes feel like they’re 'asleep' constantly. Doctor: Any joint pain or night sweats? Patient: Yes, the joints in my knees are quite stiff lately. Doctor: Let’s look at the nose... mucosal ulceration noted, significant crusting. Neuro: decreased pinprick sensation in feet, stocking distribution. BP 135/85, HR 78. Labs: Cr 1.6, elevated CRP, ANC-positive. Urinalysis: microscopic hematuria. CXR: small cavitary lesion in the right upper lobe. Imp: Presentation is classic for Granulomatosis with polyangiitis. I'm concerned about the renal involvement given the hematuria. Plan: Urgent admit for ANCA confirmation and biopsy. Start high-dose methylprednisolone and cyclophosphamide. Nephro consult requested.

Paciente, 24M, c/o palpitações súbitas e tontura 3x/semana. ECG em repouso mostra PR curto e onda delta característica. Dx: Síndrome de Wolff-Parkinson-White. Encaminhado à cardiologia para estudo eletrofisiológico.

42M c/o persistent polyuria and polydipsia, drinking ~6L water/day. Denies DM (HGT random 92 mg/dL). No peripheral edema, no sig past hx. Labs show serum Na 149 mEq/L, Uosm 180 mOsm/kg despite high plasma osmolality (305 mOsm/kg). Dx central diabetes insipidus. Starting Desmopressin 60mcg SL tid; outpatient endo f/u for pituitary MRI and water deprivation test confirmation.

S: 28M, office worker. Presents for consult to secure a medical clearance for his new job at a logistics company. Reports no current symptoms, no chronic illnesses. Denies cough, fever, or weight loss. No maintenance meds.

O: BP 110/70, HR 78, RR 18. HEENT: clear, no scleral icterus. Chest: clear to auscultation. Heart: regular rhythm, no murmurs. Abdomen: soft, nontender, no masses. Skin: no rashes or lesions noted.

Ix: CBC and Chest X-ray performed today—both results within normal limits.

A: Fit to work. No contraindications noted on physical exam.

P: Issued medical certificate for employment requirement. Advised to maintain healthy lifestyle.

Hasta, şantiyede temizlik işçisi olarak çalışıyor. Dün tank temizliği sırasında eldivenlerinin içine sızan endüstriyel tipteki konsantre kireç çözücü (asit bazlı) kimyasala maruz kalmış. Her iki el dorsalinde ve parmak aralarında şiddetli yanma, ödem ve eritem mevcut. Fizik muayenede vezikülasyon ve yer yer erozyonlar izlendi. Bölge hemen bol su ile irrige edildi. Topikal steroid ve antibiyotikli pomad reçete edildi, yara bakımı eğitimi verildi. İşyeri ortamında kimyasal temas için KKD (Kişisel Koruyucu Donanım) kullanımı konusunda iş güvenliği birimi uyarıldı.

58yo F, mengeluh nyeri perut kanan atas (RUQ) menetap sejak 3 minggu, disertai penurunan BB drastis (5kg) dan jaundice ringan. Riwayat batu empedu (+), tidak pernah operasi. O/E: Sclera ikterik, nyeri tekan RUQ (+), tidak teraba massa jelas. Hasil USG abdomen: massa heterogen ukuran 4cm pada dinding gallbladder dengan penebalan dinding lokal. Imp: Adenocarcinoma of the gallbladder. Plan: Rujuk ke RSUD untuk tindakan bedah dan CT scan kontras; edukasi mengenai prognosis dan tindakan biopsi/operasi.

Paciente varón, 45 años, diestro, trabaja como carpintero. Refiere dolor insidioso en epicóndilo lateral del codo derecho de 3 semanas de evolución, exacerbado al agarrar herramientas o girar el destornillador. Niega trauma agudo o parestesias.
O/E: Sensibilidad local marcada sobre el epicóndilo lateral. Test de Cozen (+) con dolor irradiado al antebrazo proximal al resistir la extensión de muñeca. Fuerza de prensión conservada pero dolorosa. Sin signos de inflamación cutánea ni inestabilidad articular.
Dx: Epicondilitis medial (codo de tenista). 
Plan: Reposo relativo, evitar esfuerzos de carga. AINEs tópicos (Diclofenaco gel) c/8h. Pauta de ejercicios de estiramiento excéntrico. Derivación a fisioterapia si no mejora en 4 semanas.

A/C: 4yo boy, brought by mother. Presents with itchy, erythematous rash on face and neck for 3 days. Mthr admits applying 'local herbal balm' bought from market to soothe insect bites. 

O/E: Symmetrical erythematous, papular, and excoriated plaques following distribution of balm application. No facial swelling. Mucosae clear. T 36.8C. 

Imp: Allergic reaction to topical ointment.

Plan: Stop all local balms immediately. Cetirizine syrup 2.5mg nocte x 5/7. Hydrocortisone 1% cream applied thinly to affected areas BID. Keep nails short. Return in 1/52 or if rash spreads/weeps.

S: 28F, G2P1, 14+2 weeks gestation. Presents with vague, persistent pelvic discomfort and generalized malaise over the last 5 days. No vaginal bleeding or discharge reported. Denies fever, dysuria, or abdominal trauma. History of mild morning sickness currently resolving.
O: BP 115/75, HR 82, T 36.7. Abdomen soft, non-tender, fundus not yet palpable above symphysis. Speculum exam shows healthy cervix, closed os, no blood in vault. Fetal heart tones (Doppler) present at 150 bpm.
Ix: Urine dipstick negative for leukocytes/nitrites. Hb 12.1 g/dL.
A: Maternal disorder in early pregnancy. Symptoms likely related to physiologic changes.
P: Reassurance given. Advised to maintain hydration and follow up if bleeding or severe pain occurs. Routine prenatal check-up in 4 weeks.

Doctor: Karibu, Mama. Pole sana kwa hali yako ya uchovu na kuvimba miguu. Nini kinakusumbua zaidi siku hizi?
Patient: Daktari, asante. Ni hii pumzi inakata ovyo, hata nikitembea tu kidogo kutoka jikoni kwenda sebuleni, nafika nimechoka sana. Na miguu imeanza kuvimba, viatu havinitoshi.
Doctor: Hiyo changamoto ya kupumua imekuwa kwa muda gani? Unapata shida kulala ukiwa umelala chali (flat)?
Patient: Imeanza kama wiki mbili hivi. Ndio, nikilala lazima niweke mito kama mitatu ndio nipate raha kidogo, la sivyo nahisi kama nahema.
Doctor: Tutaangalia presha yako na kufanya ECG haraka. Vitals zako zinasemaje, Nurse? 
Nurse: BP 155/95, HR 92, SpO2 91% on room air. Weight imepanda kilo tatu tangu visit iliyopita.
Doctor: Sawa. Miguu ina pitting edema +2. Listen to heart... S1/S2 present, but I hear a third heart sound (S3). Mapafu yana crackles kidogo basal zones.
Patient: Je, ni tatizo la mapafu au ni nini kinanisababishia hivi?
Doctor: Inaonekana moyo wako unapata shida kusukuma damu vizuri mwilini, ndio maana maji yanarudi nyuma kwenye mapafu na miguu. We are looking at heart failure here.
Patient: Sasa daktari, hii inamaanisha nini kwa afya yangu ya baadaye?
Doctor: Tutaagiza Echocardiogram kuona jinsi misuli ya moyo inavyofanya kazi vizuri. Kwa sasa, nitakuandikia Lasix 40mg OD kusaidia kutoa hayo maji mwilini, na nitakuongezea ACE inhibitor.
Patient: Sawa daktari, nitaanza hizo dawa leo. Nitahitaji kurudi lini?
Doctor: Return in 1 week with blood results (U&Es) and the Echo report. Jaribu kupunguza chumvi kwa sasa.

Pasien laki-laki, 58 thn, kontrol rutin via teleconsult. Keluhan utama pusing berulang dan sesekali gatal setelah mandi air hangat (aquagenic pruritus). Tidak ada nyeri dada atau sesak napas. Hasil lab terakhir: Hb 18.2 g/dL, Hct 56%, trombosit 520.000/uL, leukosit 12.500/uL. Status: stabil, TD 135/85, HR 78x/mnt reguler. Limpa tidak teraba. Rencana: Lanjutkan phlebotomy setiap 2 minggu sampai Hct <45%. Tambahkan Aspirin dosis rendah 100mg OD. Cek ulang JAK2 mutation status dan kadar eritropoietin minggu depan. Kontrol 1 bulan lagi untuk evaluasi hematologi.

Patient: 张先生, 65岁. 
主诉: 降压药已用尽，今日来诊所补开处方。
病史: 既往有高血压病史，目前服用Lisinopril 10mg每日一次，血压控制良好。无头晕、头痛、胸痛等不适。体格检查: BP 135/85 mmHg，脉搏齐，心音正常。 
计划: 续开Lisinopril 10mg，3个月用量。已告知患者继续保持低盐饮食，并建议按期进行年度常规体检。

Bệnh nhân nữ 24t, tiền sử khỏe mạnh, c/o nổi mẩn ngứa toàn thân x1/7 sau khi ăn tiệc, kèm sưng nhẹ môi và mi mắt. Không khó thở, không đau bụng. T 37.2, PR 88, SpO2 99%. Khám thấy hồng ban dạng mảng rải rác khắp thân mình. Dx: Dị ứng chưa rõ nguyên nhân. Rx: Cetirizine 10mg uống 1v/ngày x5/7, bôi tại chỗ. Tái khám nếu khó thở hoặc sưng họng.

Telehealth consult with mother of 18-month-old male from rural village. Mother reports child has 'bowed legs' which are getting worse, especially noticeable when he tries to stand. He started walking later than his siblings and is now unsteady. Child is on maize-based porridge diet. No history of trauma. O/E (via video): Significant outward bowing of both tibiae (genu varum). Forearms appear slightly bowed as well. Wrist joints look prominent/knobby. Chest shows Harrison sulcus. Child is below the 3rd centile for height. No history of fits. Given the presentation of bowed legs and classic rachitic rosary in this setting, consistent with nutritional rickets. Plan: Start high-dose oral Vitamin D3 50,000 IU weekly for 8 weeks then maintenance, calcium supplementation, and nutrition education for mother on enriching porridge with locally available legumes and greens. Follow up in 4 weeks for reassessment.

Patient (m, 28J) stellt sich zur Eignungsuntersuchung vor. Bei körperlicher Untersuchung zeigt sich eine persistierende Syndaktylie an Fingern III und IV der rechten Hand (Webbed fingers), ansonsten klinisch unauffälliger Befund. Keine Beeinträchtigung der Greiffunktion bei der Arbeit. Arbeitsfähig.

62M, dairy farmer, presents with 3/12 history of progressive dyspnea on exertion and dry, hacking cough. No fever or wheeze. Patient reports symptoms worsen significantly after working in the hay loft, with some systemic malaise and mild chills post-exposure. 

O/E: SpO2 91% on room air, RR 22. Auscultation reveals fine bibasilar end-inspiratory crackles. No clubbing. 

Ix: CXR shows diffuse reticulonodular infiltrates. Spirometry indicates a restrictive pattern with reduced DLCO. 

Imp: Clinical presentation highly suspicious for Farmer's Lung given occupational history and environmental trigger. 

Plan: Recommend strict avoidance of moldy hay/dust, use of N95 mask if unavoidable. Start prednisone 40mg daily with a taper over 6 weeks. Refer to Respirology for formal bronchoscopy/BAL to confirm. Follow up in 2 weeks to monitor O2 sats and symptomatic response.

Daktari: Mama, mtoto anaendelea aje? Nini kinakusumbua leo?
Mama: Huyu mtoto anaumwa sana. Tangu azaliwe amekuwa na shida ya kulisha, na anaonekana kama anachoka haraka sana akilia.
Daktari: Sawa, hebu nimwone. Ana miaka mingapi?
Mama: Ana miaka minne sasa.
Daktari: Sawa. (Daktari anachunguza mtoto). Ninaona ana ulemavu wa kaakaa laini na anaonekana ana uso wa kipekee, masikio yamekaa chini.
Mama: Ndio, amekuwa na maambukizi ya sikio kila wakati.
Daktari: Nimemsikiliza moyo, kuna sauti isiyo ya kawaida. Vipi kuhusu historia ya maambukizi ya kawaida?
Mama: Ndio, kila mara anashikwa na homa na anaonekana ana kinga dhaifu.
Daktari: Sawa, baada ya kuona sifa hizi za uso, shida ya moyo, na historia ya maambukizi, naona ni muonekano wa CATCH 22 phenotype.
Mama: Hiyo inamaanisha nini?
Daktari: Ni tatizo la kijenetiki linalohitaji uchunguzi zaidi wa moyo na kinga ya mwili. Nitakuandikia rufaa kwenda hospitali kubwa kwa vipimo vya damu na echocardiogram.

S: 42-j. Pat., liest in der Buchhaltung, beklagt seit 3 Wochen ziehende Schmerzen an der rechten Schulter. Keine Trauma-Anamnese, keine Vorerkrankungen. Schmerz bei Überkopfbewegungen.

O: Lokale Druckschmerzhaftigkeit ventral/lateral, leicht schmerzhafte Abduktion ab 90 Grad. Pseudoschmerz bei passiver Bewegung. Keine Rötung, keine Überwärmung.

Ix: Röntgen Schulter rechts (ap/outlet) zum Ausschluss knöcherner Veränderungen o.B.

A: Bursitis. DD: Impingement-Syndrom.

P: Ibuprofen 600mg bei Bedarf (max 2/d), physio-therapeutische Übungen, Schonung, bei fehlender Besserung in 2 Wochen Wiedervorstellung.

48F c/o vague lower abdominal bloating and sensation of fullness x3/12. No change in bowel habits or weight loss. O/E: pelvic exam reveals a firm, non-tender, mobile left adnexal mass ~5cm. Transvaginal US: 5.2cm solid, hypoechoic ovarian mass with acoustic shadowing, no internal vascularity, findings classic for ovarian fibroma. Plan: refer to Gyn for scheduled laparoscopic resection.

28F, G2P1, 32w gestation. Presented to obs clinic today complaining of intense, generalized itching, worse at night. Denies jaundice, abdominal pain, or dark urine. Skin exam shows multiple excoriations on arms and legs due to scratching; no primary rash or burrows seen. LFTs and bile acids sent. Current plan: Calamine lotion, oral antihistamines, and monitoring. Advised to return if yellowing of eyes/skin or change in fetal movements. Dx: Pruritus of pregnancy. Review once blood results available.

28F, P3+0, presented today complaining of continuous leakage of urine per vagina since her last home delivery 4 months ago. She reports being constantly wet and unable to control urine flow. Physical exam reveals a macerated perineum with persistent pooling of urine in the vaginal vault. On speculum exam, we noted a clear defect in the anterior vaginal wall through which urine is seen trickling from the bladder neck into the vaginal canal. No other masses or prolapse noted. Patient is distressed and has developed skin excoriation. Referred for surgical consult and planning for formal repair. Current plan: keep skin clean, barrier cream, and proceed with further workup.

42M, obrero de la construcción, viene por dolor testicular derecho de inicio insidioso hace 3 días, tipo punzada, escala 5/10. No fiebre, no disuria, no secreciones uretrales. Niega traumatismo reciente o levantamiento de pesas excesivo.
O/E: T 36.8, FC 78, PA 120/80. Testículo derecho ligeramente sensible a la palpación, polo superior sin signos de torsión, reflejo cremastérico presente. No hay masas palpables, no transiluminación positiva (descartado hidrocele clínico). Piel escrotal normal, sin eritema ni calor local.
Ix: U/A negativo para nitritos/leucocitos. No sospecha de ITU.
Imp: Dolor testicular de etiología no especificada. Se descarta epididimitis aguda por ausencia de síntomas sugestivos.
Plan: Paracetamol 500mg c/8h por 5 días. Reposo relativo, evitar esfuerzos físicos intensos. Uso de soporte escrotal. Signos de alarma explicados (aumento de dolor, fiebre, inflamación súbita). R/v si no mejora en 1 semana.

Patient stellt sich per Videosprechstunde vor. Klage über akute, stark schmerzhafte Schwellung am Analrand seit gestern Abend. Kein Fieber, keine abdominellen Beschwerden, kein Stuhlgang mit Blut. Inspektion per Video zeigt eine pralle, bläuliche, ca. 1 cm große Schwellung direkt an der Analveränderung (3-Uhr-Position). Konsistenz fest-elastisch. Diagnose: Akute perianale Venenthrombose. Empfehlung: Hämatom-Kühlung mit Eispack, Sitzbäder mit Eichenrinde, lokale Analgetika. Stuhlregulation mit Macrogol, um lokalen Druck zu minimieren. Bei Zunahme der Schmerzen oder Infektzeichen Wiedervorstellung zur evtl. Inzision/Exzision.

S: 9yo M brought in by mother c/o sudden episodes of palpitations and 'dizzy spells' for the past 2 weeks. No history of chest pain or syncope. Child appears active at baseline but complains of feeling his heart 'beating fast' during play. No recent fever or preceding viral illness. O: Alert, looks well. T 36.8, PR 165 (irregular), BP 105/65, RR 22, SpO2 99% on RA. Heart sounds are rapid, no murmurs detected. Lungs clear. No pedal oedema or hepatomegaly. Ix: Resting ECG shows irregular tachycardia with no clear p-waves. RDT for malaria negative. Hb 11.2. A: Cardiac arrhythmia, clinical observation. P: Referred to cardiology clinic at UCH for urgent 24-hr Holter monitor and echocardiogram. Advised mother to keep a diary of symptoms and present to ER immediately if child develops chest pain, breathlessness, or faints.

Doctor: Mama, tell me about the baby. I see you are very worried.
Patient: Doctor, he was born yesterday at home, but he had a very difficult delivery. Now look at his head, it feels soft and it is getting bigger on one side.
Doctor: Let me examine him. Yes, I see a fluctuant swelling here on the right parietal region. It does not cross the suture lines. How is he feeding?
Patient: He is sucking well and he hasn't been vomiting. He just keeps sleeping.
Doctor: Is he having any seizures or arching his back?
Patient: No, he is just resting. Is it dangerous?
Doctor: The swelling is limited to one bone area, which is a good sign. It is a collection of blood under the periosteum from the pressure of birth. It is a cephalohaematoma.
Patient: Will it go away on its own?
Doctor: Yes, it will gradually reabsorb over a few weeks. Avoid pressing on it or trying to drain it, as that can cause infection. Just keep him warm and continue breastfeeding. Watch for any unusual drowsiness or if he stops feeding, and bring him back immediately if that happens. We will monitor his hemoglobin since he lost some blood into that swelling.

Pasien laki-laki, 34 tahun, bekerja di lapangan. Datang dengan keluhan sering merasa cemas dan gemetar hebat jika belum mengonsumsi 'obat' yang ia beli dari kenalan (zat tidak diketahui jenisnya). Gejala putus zat muncul jika tidak pakai >12 jam. Sudah mencoba berhenti sendiri namun gagal karena gejala fisik mengganggu pekerjaan. O/E: TD 135/85, HR 98, pupil tidak dilatasi, tremor halus pada kedua tangan. Tidak ditemukan tanda intoksikasi akut saat ini. Rencana: Konsul ke psikiatri untuk tatalaksana ketergantungan zat, cek urin narkoba standar (panel luas), cuti medis 3 hari untuk observasi awal. Edukasi bahaya penggunaan zat yang tidak teridentifikasi.

48F, pt reports recurrent episodes of intense room-spinning dizziness occurring mostly when turning over in bed or bending down to tie shoes. Each episode lasts < 1 minute and is associated with mild nausea. No hearing loss, tinnitus, or headache reported. No recent URI or ear infections. Neuro exam normal; no focal deficits. Dix-Hallpike maneuver performed during video consult: positive for geotropic nystagmus lasting ~30 seconds when head turned to the right. Imp: BPPV (right). Plan: Instructed on Epley maneuver for home use. Advised to sleep with head elevated and avoid rapid head movements. Will follow up in 1/52 if symptoms persist.

68F, c/o episódios recorrentes de tontura rotatória intensa ao virar na cama ou levantar-se subitamente. Episódios duram < 1 min, associados a náuseas leves. Nega zumbido ou perda auditiva. Manobra de Dix-Hallpike: nistagmo torsional latente e exausto no lado direito. Restante do exame otológico normal. Imp: VPPB. Plano: Manobra de Epley realizada com sucesso em consultório. Instruções de repouso relativo, retorno se recorrência.

32M, presents with long-standing concern regarding sexual performance. Pt reports that since his mid-20s, he has consistently experienced ejaculation within 30-60 seconds of vaginal penetration, regardless of the partner or the circumstances. Denies erectile dysfunction, libido issues, or history of trauma. No history of anxiety or substance use. O/E: BP 120/80, BMI 24.5, genitourinary exam normal, no signs of prostatitis or phimosis. Labs: TSH, FBS, and lipids within normal limits. Impression: Consistent, generalized premature ejaculation. Plan: Started behavioral therapy techniques (squeeze-stop method), advised on potential use of topical lidocaine-prilocaine cream if needed, and discussed follow-up in 4 weeks to monitor response.

BN, 34 tuổi, tiền sử khỏe mạnh. Bệnh nhân đến khám vì tình trạng da khô, ngứa và đỏ ở vùng khuỷu tay và sau đầu gối khoảng 3 tuần nay. Tình trạng ngứa tăng lên vào ban đêm, không có tiền sử dị ứng thuốc hay hóa chất mới sử dụng gần đây. Khám lâm sàng thấy các mảng da bị lichen hóa, đỏ, có rỉ dịch nhẹ ở nếp gấp khuỷu. Không có tổn thương dạng nốt hay xuất huyết. Phổi trong, tim đều. Chẩn đoán: Viêm da chưa xác định rõ loại. Kế hoạch: Bôi kem dưỡng ẩm dày (emollient) 2 lần/ngày, dùng thêm kem hydrocortisone 1% bôi vùng tổn thương trong 7 ngày, tránh xà phòng mạnh. Hẹn tái khám sau 2 tuần nếu không cải thiện.

S: Pz. 54aa, riferisce peggioramento estetico e fastidio alle unghie dei piedi da circa 6 mesi. Nega dolore acuto o secrezione purulenta. Nessuna patologia sistemica nota.

O: Esame obiettivo unghie: ipercheratosi subungueale evidente, onicolisi distale e discromia giallastra-biancastra che interessa le lamine di entrambi gli alluci. Non segni di paronichia attiva. Polsi periferici presenti, sensibilità conservata.

Ix: Test micologico su frammenti di lamina: positivo per dermatofiti.

A: Onicomicosi confermata.

P: Spiegata terapia topica con amorolfina smalto 5% 2 volte/settimana. In caso di fallimento, rivalutare opzioni sistemiche (terbinafina). Igiene podologica rigorosa. Follow-up tra 3 mesi.

P: 42M, teknisi lapangan, mengeluh mata sering kabur dan cepat lelah saat membaca blueprint atau melihat layar komputer di site. Gejala terasa sejak 3 bulan terakhir, makin memberat di sore hari. Tidak ada nyeri mata, sekret, atau riwayat trauma. Riwayat DM/HT disangkal.
O/E: VOD 6/9, VOS 6/9. Segmen anterior tenang. Tekanan intraokular 16/17 mmHg. Funduskopi dalam batas normal. Tes konfrontasi lapang pandang normal. Pupil isokor, refleks cahaya (+/+) normal. Gerakan bola mata bebas ke segala arah.
Imp: Keluhan penglihatan (visual complaint) saat bekerja.
Plan: Edukasi higiene visual dan aturan 20-20-20. Rujuk ke optometry untuk refraksi tajam. Follow up jika tidak ada perbaikan dengan kacamata yang sesuai.

Dokter: Selamat pagi Ibu Siti, apa yang bisa saya bantu hari ini?
Pasien: Pagi Dok. Saya merasa tidak enak badan, pinggang bawah saya nyeri sekali dan saya merasa ingin buang air kecil terus, tapi keluarnya sedikit-sedikit dan perih.
Dokter: Sudah berapa hari Ibu merasakan keluhan seperti ini?
Pasien: Baru dua hari ini Dok, tapi rasanya makin mengganggu. Saya juga merasa agak demam.
Dokter: Apakah ada keluhan lain seperti keputihan atau darah saat kencing?
Pasien: Tidak ada keputihan Dok, darah juga tidak terlihat.
Dokter: Baik, saya periksa dulu ya. (Pemeriksaan fisik: Suhu 37.8C, nyeri ketok CVA negatif, suprapubik nyeri tekan (+)).
Dokter: Baiklah, dari keluhan dan pemeriksaan tadi, sepertinya ada infeksi di saluran kemih Ibu.
Pasien: Apakah perlu obat keras Dok?
Dokter: Iya, saya akan berikan antibiotik untuk mengatasi infeksinya dan obat untuk mengurangi rasa perihnya.
Dokter: Saya juga akan minta Ibu untuk memberikan sampel urin untuk memastikan diagnosa dan melihat kuman apa yang ada.
Pasien: Baik Dokter, terima kasih.
Dokter: Sama-sama. Pastikan minum air putih yang banyak dan jangan menahan kencing ya.

S: Bé N.V.A, 7 tuổi, đưa đi khám vì đái dầm ban đêm liên tục. Mẹ cho biết bé vẫn tè dầm hằng đêm, ảnh hưởng sinh hoạt và tâm lý bé. Không có tiền sử nhiễm trùng tiểu, tiểu buốt hay uống nước quá nhiều trước khi ngủ.
O: Thăm khám lâm sàng bình thường. Tim, phổi ổn. Bụng mềm, không cầu bàng quang. Phản xạ gân xương bình thường.
Ix: Tổng phân tích nước tiểu: Bình thường (không đạm, không đường, không bạch cầu/nitrit).
A: Đái dầm về đêm.
P: Tư vấn thay đổi lối sống: hạn chế uống nước sau 19h, đi vệ sinh trước khi ngủ. Hẹn tái khám sau 4 tuần để theo dõi tiến triển.

S: 24F, presents for annual review. Reports worsening nasal congestion, sneezing and itchy, watery eyes, particularly when in her bedroom or spending time cleaning. Symptoms persistent throughout the year. Taking OTC loratadine with minimal effect.
O: Examination reveals pale, boggy nasal turbinates with clear rhinorrhoea. No signs of infection. Chest clear, no wheeze.
Ix: Skin prick test positive for Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus.
A: Allergic rhinitis secondary to house dust mite sensitivity.
P: Start fluticasone propionate nasal spray 50mcg, 2 sprays in each nostril once daily. Advise on house dust mite avoidance measures: allergen-proof bedding covers, vacuuming with HEPA filter, and regular damp dusting. Continue antihistamine as needed. Review in 4 weeks.

S: 45F, teacher, c/o painful thick skin on both soles x 6 months. Tried over-the-counter urea creams with no improvement. Denies any trauma or new shoes. No joint pain.

O: Multiple small, sterile yellowish-brown pustules on erythematous, hyperkeratotic plaques involving both soles. No lesions on palms. No nail pits. No signs of secondary infection.

Ix: Skin swab for bacterial/fungal culture - pending. 

A: Classic presentation of chronic pustular eruption of the feet.

P: Start Clobetasol propionate ointment under occlusion at night. Advised soaking feet daily. Refer for phototherapy if no response in 4 weeks. Patient educated on avoiding mechanical irritation.

Paciente: 34F, trabalha em linha de montagem, comparece com queixas de ardor e vermelhidão intensa na região inframamária e dobras inguinais. Nega uso de novos produtos de limpeza ou sabonetes. Relata que o desconforto piorou nas últimas duas semanas devido ao calor excessivo e aumento da sudorese durante o turno de trabalho. Ao exame: placas eritematosas bem delimitadas, com maceração e fissuras superficiais nas dobras cutâneas bilaterais, sem exsudato purulento ou odor fétido. Sem acometimento de palmas ou plantas. P: Dermatite intertriginosa causada por fricção e calor. Orientada a manter a pele seca, uso de roupas de algodão mais leves e evitar exposição prolongada à umidade. Prescrito creme de óxido de zinco para barreira cutânea. Retorno em 10 dias se não houver melhora.

48M, kamyon şoförü. Eşi, hastanın gece uykuda çok yüksek sesle horladığını, bazen nefesinin durduğunu ve ardından yüksek sesle horlayarak uyandığını belirtiyor. Hasta gün içinde aşırı uykulu, direksiyon başında uyuklamaktan korkuyor. Eşlik eden HT var, düzenli takipte. Sigara: 10 paket/yıl. BMI: 34 kg/m². O/E: TA 155/95, VKİ yüksek, boyun çevresi kalın, orofarenks dar (Mallampati III). Kalp ve akciğer sesleri doğal. İmp: Horlama ve gündüz uyuklaması ile seyreden Obstrüktif Uyku Apnesi şüphesi. Plan: Kilo verme, yaşam tarzı değişikliği. Uyku çalışması (polisomnografi) için sevk. HT takibi devam, tansiyon takibi çizelgesi istendi. 2 hafta sonra kontrol.

54M, farmer, c/o dull, heavy ache in both legs worsening by end of day. History of visible, twisty veins for several years. Denies chest pain, shortness of breath, or palpitations. No history of injury or recent long-distance travel. 

O/E: BP 130/85, HR 76. Visible tortuous superficial veins noted on both calves. No signs of DVT (Homan’s sign negative, calves soft, no unilateral swelling). Pulses palpable bilaterally in dorsalis pedis. Skin intact, no ulceration or brown pigmentation. 

Plan: Advised on elevation of legs and use of compression stockings. Referred for lifestyle modification and weight reduction. Return to clinic if pain worsens or if any skin changes develop.

Patiente de 24 ans, accouchement il y a 3 semaines. Se plaint de douleur intense au sein gauche avec fièvre et frissons depuis 2 jours. À l'examen : sein gauche chaud, érythémateux avec une zone fluctuante et très douloureuse au cadran supéro-externe. Température : 38.9°C. Diagnostic : abcès du sein. Prise en charge : drainage chirurgical sous anesthésie locale et antibiothérapie par cloxacilline. À revoir dans 3 jours pour pansement.

82F presents with persistent epiphora and irritation of the left eye over the past 3 months. Pt notes the lower lid feels 'slack' and does not sit properly against the globe. PMH significant for hypertension and age-related macular degeneration. O/E: Visible sagging of the left lower eyelid with conjunctival hyperaemia. The punctum is everted and no longer apposed to the ocular surface, causing secondary overflow tearing. No cicatricial changes or orbital masses. Diagnosis: Senile ectropion of eyelid. Plan: Lubricating eye drops QDS and discussed referral for surgical correction of the lid margin if conservative measures fail to alleviate irritation.

Paciente, 54a, refere dor lombar baixa irradiada para MMII direito com início há cerca de 3 meses. Descreve sensação de choque e formigamento ocasional na face posterior da coxa e panturrilha. Nega perda de força ou incontinência esfincteriana. Ao exame: Marcha preservada. Lasègue positivo à direita aos 45°. Reflexos patelar e aquileu presentes e simétricos. Sem déficits motores grosseiros. Exames laboratoriais de rotina sem alterações significativas. HD: Radiculopatia, a esclarecer etiologia. Plano: Solicito RMN de coluna lombossacra. Prescrito Gabapentina 300mg/dia para controle da dor neuropática. Retorno após realização do exame de imagem.

Patiente de 68 ans, adressée pour une lésion douloureuse de l'hélix gauche évoluant depuis 3 mois. À l'examen clinique, présence d'un petit nodule ferme, légèrement érythémateux, avec une croûte centrale ulcérée, typique d'une chondrodermatite nodulaire. Sensibilité marquée à la palpation et inconfort lors du décubitus latéral. Pas d'adénopathie associée. Diagnostic retenu : Chondrodermatite nodulaire. Stratégie thérapeutique : conseils d'évitement de pression, application de dermocorticoïdes puissants et cryothérapie localisée si échec du traitement initial. Merci de votre prise en charge.

S: 54M, known HTN. Sudden onset intense pain/swelling in R big toe (1st MTP) since last night. Pt unable to wear shoe. No recent trauma. Reports history of similar episodes. Diet rich in red meat, frequent beer consumption.
O: R 1st MTP joint erythematous, hot, markedly tender, swelling with limited ROM. Tophi visible on R ear cartilage and olecranon. Vitals: T 37.4, HR 88, BP 145/90.
Ix: Serum uric acid 9.8 mg/dL. Synovial fluid aspiration (from MTP) shows needle-shaped crystals with negative birefringence.
Imp: Tophaceous gout flare.
Plan: NSAIDs (Indomethacin 50mg TID x 5/7). Start Allopurinol 100mg QD after acute inflammation subsides. Dietary counseling/lifestyle modification. F/U in rheumatology clinic for titration.

Dear Dr. García, I am referring Sra. Lopez, 42F, for assessment of persistent, disabling postural headaches. She describes a 'heavy' headache that worsens within 15 minutes of standing and improves significantly when lying flat. Symptoms began spontaneously two weeks ago following a bout of heavy lifting. Exam shows no meningeal signs or fever. MRI spine/brain demonstrates diffuse pachymeningeal enhancement and descent of the cerebellar tonsils consistent with spontaneous intracranial hypotension. She has been managed with bed rest and hydration with poor response. Given the classic postural nature and imaging findings, I am referring her for consideration of an epidural blood patch. BP 115/75, HR 72, temp 36.6. Please advise on further neuroimaging or urgent intervention.

Пациентка 44 лет, телемедицинский осмотр. Повторный визит. На учете в связи с установленным саркоидозом. Жалобы: усилившийся сухой кашель, одышка при физической нагрузке, периодические боли за грудиной. Объективно: ЧДД 19, SpO2 94% в покое, при нагрузочной пробе (3 мин) снижение до 89%. Аускультативно: жесткое дыхание, единичные сухие хрипы. По КТ ОГК (от 12.05): выраженная интерстициальная инфильтрация, увеличение внутригрудных лимфоузлов. Спирометрия: умеренные рестриктивные нарушения. План: учитывая прогрессирование поражения легочной ткани, инициировать прием преднизолона 30 мг/сут с постепенным снижением под контролем функции дыхания. Контроль АД, глюкозы крови. Повторный осмотр через 2 недели.

62-jährige Patientin, bekannt mit arterieller Hypertonie und Herzinsuffizienz. Vorstellung heute wegen zunehmender peripherer Ödeme, ausgeprägter Müdigkeit und neu aufgetretener, schmerzhafter Schwellung im Bereich des linken Sprunggelenks. Patientin berichtet, sie habe vor zwei Wochen ihre Medikation umgestellt bekommen. Aktuelle Medikation: Ramipril 10mg, Amlodipin 10mg, Metoprolol 95mg. Vitals: RR 145/90 mmHg, Puls 78 bpm, SpO2 96%. Körperliche Untersuchung: Beidseitige Knöchelödeme Grad II, Haut an den Unterschenkeln gerötet und gespannt, kein Hinweis auf TVT. Herz auskultatorisch unauffällig. Labor: Kreatinin leicht erhöht, Elektrolyte im Normbereich. Es zeigt sich ein klassisches Bild einer Amlodipin-induzierten Vasodilatation mit konsekutiven Ödemen. Assessment: Ödeme unter bestehender Amlodipin-Therapie. Plan: Absetzen von Amlodipin. Umstellung auf eine andere Substanzklasse zur Blutdruckeinstellung (z.B. Candesartan). Wiedervorstellung in 14 Tagen zur Kontrolle.

68M, brought by wife. C/o progressive 'forgetfulness' and 'confusion' over the last 18 months. Wife reports he frequently misplaces keys, asks the same questions repeatedly, and has become notably withdrawn socially. No history of stroke or TIA reported by family. No motor deficits on exam. MMSE: 21/30 (deficits in orientation and delayed recall). Gait normal. Vitals: BP 135/85, HR 78. Currently on no regular psychotropic meds. Plan: Routine bloods (B12, folate, TSH, glucose) to rule out metabolic/reversible causes. Referral for neuropsychological testing to further characterize cognitive decline. Advised to return with results for cognitive assessment and discussion of support services.

38M, welder at industrial site, presented for annual occupational medical clearance. Reports frequent exposure to heavy metal fumes and fine particulates during pipe fabrication. Complains of occasional dry cough during shift, improving on days off. CXR unremarkable, spirometry showed FEV1/FVC 82%. P/E: no wheeze or crackles, SpO2 99% on RA. Plan: Cleared for duty, but emphasized strict adherence to N95 respirator protocol and mandatory use of local exhaust ventilation. Discussed respiratory protection education.

28F, G3P2, 28/40 GA, at antenatal clinic for follow-up. c/o persistent pain and mild swelling around the venous line site in her right arm. Pt had an emergency admission 5 days ago for severe hyperemesis gravidarum, treated with IV fluids. 

O/E: Site of central venous catheter shows local redness, warmth, and induration. No purulent discharge or fever. Fetal heart tones 144 bpm, reassuring. 

Imp: Localized thrombophlebitis secondary to indwelling central line. 

Plan: Remove central venous catheter immediately. Warm compresses to the site. Monitor for signs of systemic infection or catheter-related bloodstream infection. Encourage oral rehydration as tolerated. Return immediately if high-grade fever develops.

Patient presents for follow-up regarding chronic weight management concerns. BMI is 34.2 kg/m2. BP 135/85 mmHg. Patient reports difficulty maintaining dietary adherence despite exercise. No symptoms of secondary endocrine causes reported. Labs (HbA1c, TSH, fasting glucose) within normal limits. Plan: Discussed lifestyle modifications and intensive nutritional counseling. To initiate weight loss program and follow up in 3 months for progress monitoring.

Doctor: Hola, buenos días. ¿Qué le trae hoy a la consulta?
Paciente: Doctor, traigo a mi hijo de 6 años. Siempre me dicen en la escuela que camina como encogido, con el cuello muy corto y como si no pudiera moverlo bien hacia los lados.
Doctor: Ya veo. ¿Ha notado si se queja de dolor o si tiene dificultad para mirar atrás al cruzar la calle?
Paciente: Sí, siempre tiene que girar todo el cuerpo para ver quién le habla. Y parece que tiene la línea del cabello muy baja en la nuca.
Doctor: Voy a examinarlo. Por favor, que se siente en la camilla. Al palpar el cuello, siento que las vértebras cervicales están como fusionadas, hay muy poca movilidad pasiva en la columna cervical superior.
Paciente: ¿Es algo grave, doctor?
Doctor: Es una fusión congénita de las vértebras cervicales, lo que conocemos como una anomalía de Klippel-Feil. Explica perfectamente por qué tiene el cuello corto y limitado en sus movimientos.
Paciente: ¿Necesita cirugía?
Doctor: Por ahora no, pero necesitamos hacer una radiografía de columna cervical para ver cuántas vértebras están afectadas y descartar problemas en la médula o en los riñones. También debe evitar deportes de contacto o actividades que fuercen el cuello por riesgo de lesión. ¿Le parece bien?
Paciente: Sí, doctor. Traeré los estudios lo antes posible.

Mgonjwa ni mjamzito wa wiki 28, anakuja kwa njia ya simu akilalamika ganzi na maumivu ya kuwaka kwenye nyayo za miguu yote miwili yanayoanza usiku. Hali hii imeanza takriban mwezi mmoja uliopita. Anasema anajihisi kuchoka sana na ana historia ya kutokula vizuri miezi ya hivi karibuni kutokana na hali ya kifedha na kukosa hamu ya kula. Kwenye uchunguzi wa kimwili nimeona miguu ina edema kidogo, lakini reflex za magoti na ankle ziko chini sana (hyporeflexia). Nimejaribu kupima hisia (pinprick test), anasema anahisi ganzi kwenye vidole vya miguu. Hii inaashiria upungufu wa vitamini mwilini kutokana na lishe duni wakati huu wa ujauzito. Nimeagiza apate virutubisho vya B-complex, folic acid, na kurekebisha lishe yake haraka. Pia nimemuomba aje kliniki wiki ijayo tupime damu kuangalia kiwango cha hemoglobini na virutubisho vingine.

Ny. S, 32th, G3P2002, UK 24mg, datang keluhan nyeri pinggang & rasa mengganjal di vagina. Sering BAK, merasa ada benjolan yang keluar di sela paha terutama saat jongkok.
O/E: TD 110/70, N 84. Inspeksi vulva: tampak massa menonjol keluar dari introitus vagina, dinding anterior vagina turun, cervik tampak di depan. Tonus sfingter lemah. DJJ 145x/m.
Dx: Complete uterine prolapse with anterior vaginal wall prolapse. 
Plan: Edukasi penggunaan korset kehamilan/penyangga, hindari angkat beban berat. Kontrol ulang ANC rutin.

24F, follow-up on recurrent dizzy spells and near-syncope, mostly when standing in line at work or in the shower. Reports persistent tachycardia and lightheadedness since viral illness 3 months ago. Vitals today: sitting BP 118/76, HR 82; standing (after 10 mins) BP 115/74, HR 124. Complains of palpitations and brain fog upon standing. No palpitations while recumbent. Normal ECG last month. Assessment: Classic presentation of postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome. Plan: Counselled on increased fluid/sodium intake, compression stockings, and graded exercise program. Advised to stay well-hydrated to mitigate symptoms. Follow-up in 6 weeks to monitor status.

72-jährige Patientin, stellt sich wegen störender, herabhängender Haut an den Oberlidern vor. Chronisches Schweregefühl, besonders gegen Tagesende, Sichtfeld wird laut Pat. durch die 'Liderkappen' peripher eingeschränkt. Keine Entzündungszeichen, keine Störung des Lidschlusses. O/E: Ausgeprägter bilateraler Hautüberschuss an den Lidern mit mechanischer Ptosis. Levatorfunktion intakt. Keine Anzeichen für eine Myasthenia gravis oder endokrine Orbitopathie. Verdacht auf Dermatochalasis. Überweisung an Ophthalmologie zur Evaluation bzgl. Blepharoplastik.

S: 45y/o male complains of 'soft' erections during intercourse for the past 8 months. Previously had no issues with sexual performance for years. Reports no morning wood. Denies recent major stress, relationship problems, or new meds. No history of DM or HTN in family. O: BP 120/80, HR 78, BMI 26. Genital exam unremarkable. Prostate non-tender, normal size. Ix: FBS 85, Lipid profile: LDL 130, HDL 42. A: Erectile dysfunction, new onset, generalized. P: Advised smoking cessation, exercise, and diet modification. Started Sildenafil 50mg PRN. Requested baseline HbA1c and repeat consult in 4 weeks to monitor progress.

24F, c/o painful growth on sole of right foot x 3 months. Pt says walking feels like stepping on a small pebble, worsening lately. No hx of DM or peripheral neuropathy. O/E: Multiple hyperkeratotic papules on the plantar surface of the R heel, interrupt the normal skin lines, punctate black dots visible on paring. No surrounding cellulitis or discharge. Diagnosis: Plantar warts. Plan: Prescribed salicylic acid 40% plaster to be applied at night after soaking. Advised on hygiene and avoiding walking barefoot in public areas. Review in 4 weeks if no improvement.

3M infant brought by mother for routine check-up and immunizations. Mother noticed a small fleshy lesion on the baby's chest since birth. Denies any discharge, pain, or change in size. No other health concerns. O/E: Well-nourished, active infant. Vitals stable. Chest exam shows a small, pigmented, nipple-like structure located along the milk line inferior to the left breast. No associated mass or abnormal underlying skin changes. Rest of systemic exam normal. Assessment: Accessory nipple. Plan: Reassured mother that this is a benign developmental finding and no surgical intervention is indicated at this time. Administered routine 10-week vaccines. Advised mother to monitor for any irritation or change and return if concerned.

68M, Hx: heavy smoker. 视频咨询。患者自述近期出现间歇性无痛性肉眼血尿 (painless gross haematuria)，伴有尿频和尿急，持续约3周。无发热、腰痛或体重减轻。既往无高血压或糖尿病。查体：腹部平软，肝脾未及，肾区无叩痛。尿常规示：血尿 (+++)，镜检见异形红细胞，白细胞阴性。已嘱其即刻行尿脱落细胞学检查，并紧急开具US KUB及膀胱镜检查转诊，高度怀疑膀胱移行细胞癌。建议患者严格戒烟，近期密切随访。

45F c/o recurring 'crawling' sensations in legs mainly at night when resting, making it hard to fall asleep. Patient says she has to 'move them to stop the creepy feeling' which provides temporary relief. Symptoms start around 9 PM. No daytime sleepiness reported. Denies history of iron deficiency or recent med changes. O/E: Neuro exam unremarkable, no focal weakness. Vitals stable. Advised on sleep hygiene and avoiding caffeine late in the day. Given the classic presentation of urge to move legs with evening worsening, this is consistent with periodic limb movement disorder. Will start low-dose Gabapentin at bedtime and check ferritin levels. Follow up in 4 weeks.

48M, vorstellig per Video-Call. Beklagte seit Monaten zunehmende Belastungsdyspnoe und chronischen Husten, meist mit wenig Auswurf. Raucher (ca. 15 Packungsjahre). Keine nächtliche Orthopnoe, keine Ödeme. O/E: Thorax frei, Herz auskultatorisch o.B., SpO2 93% unter Raumluft, verlängertes Exspirium bei Auskultation der Lunge, vereinzelt Giemen basal. RR 135/85, Puls 88/min. Patient berichtet, dass es bei körperlicher Anstrengung im Feld immer schlimmer wird. Lungenfunktion vor Ort nicht möglich. Dx: Chronische obstruktive Lungenerkrankung. Plan: Salbutamol Inhalationsspray nach Bedarf, Aufklärung über Raucherentwöhnung, Wiedervorstellung bei Verschlechterung der Atemnot.

42F, teacher. c/o persistent inability to initiate and maintain sleep over the last 4 months. Reports lying awake for 2-3 hours nightly, constant rumination, and early morning wakening. Feels fatigued, irritable, and struggles with concentration at work. Denies sleep apnea symptoms, leg restlessness, or nocturnal palpitations. 

SH: High stress, excessive caffeine intake. 
O/E: BP 125/80, BMI 24. Alert but appears tired. Normal physical examination. 
Ix: Bloods unremarkable, TSH normal. 
Imp: Primary insomnia disorder. 
Plan: Initiate sleep hygiene education (no screens post 21:00, strict wake time). Trial of Melatonin 2mg 1h before bed. Review in 4/52 to monitor response; consider CBT-I referral if no improvement.

48F presents with 3/52 history of worsening fatigue, nocturnal cough, and swelling of both feet. Reports difficulty lying flat at night. O/E: JVP elevated, bibasal crackles on chest auscultation, pitting oedema up to mid-shins. BP 135/88, PR 102 reg. CVS: S3 gallop noted. CXR shows cardiomegaly with pulmonary congestion. Plan: Frusemide 40mg daily, strict salt restriction, monitor daily weights. RTC 1/52 for review.

S: 28M, presented with 4-day history of intense, throbbing pain in URQ of mouth. Radiating to temple. Unable to chew on right side. No systemic fever noted.
O: T 36.8C. Intraoral exam: Lower right first molar (46) sensitive to percussion. Deep caries present. Visible 3mm fluctuant swelling on the vestibular gingiva adjacent to 46 with a small, central point of purulent discharge.
Ix: Dental X-ray shows radiolucency at the apex of the distal root.
Imp: Periapical abscess with sinus, 46.
Plan: I&D of abscess under local anesthesia. Started Amoxicillin 500mg TDS for 5/7 and Metronidazole 400mg TDS for 5/7. Analgesia with Ibuprofen 400mg TDS. Referred to dental surgeon for urgent root canal treatment or extraction.

4-day-old male brought in by parents for general irritability and poor feeding since this morning. Mom reports he is 'just not acting right' and seems difficult to console. Born at 39 weeks via SVD, no known prenatal issues. O/E: T 98.2F, HR 155, RR 45, SpO2 99% on RA. Infant is fussy but consolable; skin turgor good, cap refill <2s. Soft spot flat. No obvious focal infection, rashes, or trauma noted on exam. Abdomen soft, non-distended. Heart and lungs clear. Given the vague symptoms and young age, referring to Pediatric ED for further workup to rule out sepsis or other systemic issues. Advised parents to head straight to the hospital.

28M, office worker. Visiting the clinic for a mandatory annual health check-up required by his employer. Feels perfectly healthy, no active complaints or medical concerns. Denies recent illness, fever, or trauma. No current maintenance meds. S: No cough, no headache, no abdominal pain. O: Wt 65kg, BP 120/80, PR 78, RR 18. General physical exam unremarkable. Heart sounds S1 S2 regular. Chest clear on auscultation. Abdomen soft, non-tender. Ix: Fasting blood sugar (FBS) 4.8 mmol/L, routine urinalysis clear. A: Patient in good health, no active medical issues identified. P: Advised to continue balanced diet and regular exercise. Clearance certificate issued for employment. Return for follow-up in one year.

45yo F presents with a 6-month history of deep, creeping sensations in her lower legs that occur exclusively in the evening while sitting on the couch to watch TV. Patient reports that moving her legs or walking around provides immediate, albeit temporary, relief. Sleep is significantly disrupted; she has difficulty falling asleep due to the need to keep moving her legs. Partner confirms frequent kicking movements during initial sleep onset. Denies daytime sleepiness. Neurological exam is unremarkable, iron studies requested to rule out deficiency. Presumptive diagnosis of RLS. Will start on iron supplementation if ferritin is low, otherwise consider pramipexole if symptoms persist.

45M c/o RUQ pain post-fatty meals for last 2 months. Pain is colicky, radiates to right shoulder blade, lasts 1-2 hours then settles. No fever, no jaundice, no dark urine or pale stools. Pt reports feeling bloated after meals. O/E: BMI 28, mild tenderness in RUQ on deep palpation. Murphy’s sign negative. No guarding or rebound. Vitals stable, HR 72, BP 130/85, Temp 36.7C. Ultrasound report reviewed: multiple small calculi within the gallbladder, no wall thickening, no pericholecystic fluid, CBD diameter 4mm (normal). Plan: Advise low-fat diet, analgesia as required. Routine referral to General Surgery for assessment regarding potential elective cholecystectomy.

32M construction worker, c/o frequency of urination for 3 weeks. Reports going to toilet every 45-60 minutes during work shift. Denies dysuria, urgency, or penile discharge. No flank pain, no fever, no haematuria noted. Drinks ~3L water daily due to heat. No known diabetes; denies polydipsia. 
O/E: BP 128/82, HR 76. Abdomen soft, non-tender, no suprapubic fullness. 
Urine dipstick: Glucose neg, protein neg, nitrites neg, leucocytes neg. 
Plan: Likely increased intake related to site conditions, but advised to avoid excessive caffeine. Ordered HbA1c to rule out occult DM. Follow up next week with results.

62M presents for follow-up of 'itchy skin' and persistent headaches. Reports increasing fatigue over the last 3 months. ROS: No fever, chills, or night sweats. PMH: Hypertension. Current meds: lisinopril. O/E: Plethoric facies, mild conjunctival injection. Abdomen: splenomegaly noted on palpation, firm, ~2cm below costal margin. BP 154/92. Initial labs from clinic show Hgb 18.2 g/dL, Hct 54%, Plt 510k, WBC 14.5k. Given elevated Hgb and splenomegaly, clinical suspicion for polycythaemia vera is high. Plan: STAT referral to hematology for JAK2 mutation testing and bone marrow biopsy. Patient advised to avoid aspirin for now pending specialist review. Will hold on routine blood donations until formal diagnosis established.

المريض: السيد أحمد، 35 سنة. 
السبب: حضر المريض اليوم عبر الاتصال المرئي لطلب الحصول على تقرير طبي رسمي لتقديمه لجهة عمله (قسم الموارد البشرية) بخصوص غيابه عن العمل لمدة يومين الأسبوع الماضي. 
التاريخ المرضي: أفاد المريض بأنه كان يعاني من أعراض عامة (توعك) وإرهاق، ولم يحتج لأي تدخل علاجي طارئ أو كشف سريري دقيق. 
الفحص: تم فحص العلامات الحيوية من قبل المريض، النبض 78، الحرارة 36.8، ولا توجد علامات حادة تستدعي إجراءات طبية إضافية. 
الخطة: تم إصدار الشهادة الطبية المطلوبة لأغراض إدارية. نصحت المريض بالمتابعة في حال ظهور أي أعراض جديدة.

S: 42M c/o pruritic rash on face and neck x2/7. Started using hydrocortisone cream on face 3/52 for mild redness, but condition worsened after switching to a 'stronger' cream from pharmacy last week. No fever, no SOB, no prior allergy hx.
O: Alert, stable. BP 120/80, HR 88, T 36.7. Exam: well-demarcated erythematous, scaly plaques on bilateral cheeks and anterior neck, conforming to area of cream application. No pustules, no facial swelling.
Ix: Nil.
A: Suspected contact dermatitis secondary to topical treatment.
P: Stop all topical corticosteroids immediately. Prescribed hydrocortisone 1% sparingly if needed for irritation, oral antihistamines (Loratadine 10mg OD). FU 1/52.

62yo female, expat, presents for routine follow-up of fatigue and glossitis. Longstanding hx of mild cognitive slowing, reported by husband. Recent bloods show Hb 9.8 g/dL, MCV 118 fL, neutrophils hypersegmented. Vit B12 < 50 pg/mL. Gastroscopy performed last month by gastro showed atrophic gastritis, biopsies confirm loss of parietal cells. Anti-intrinsic factor antibodies positive. Pt currently on PPI for dyspepsia, but primary cause identified as autoimmune gastritis. Dx: Pernicious anaemia. Plan: Initiate IM hydroxocobalamin 1mg injections per protocol. Review in 4 weeks for reticulocyte count.

68M retired teacher. Presents with intermittent palpitations over the last 2 months, described as 'skipped beats' and occasional fluttering in the chest. Denies chest pain, syncope, or SOB. No history of thyroid issues or excessive caffeine intake.

SH: Occasional glass of wine, non-smoker. No previous cardiac history. Family hx: Father had 'heart trouble' in his 70s.

O/E: BP 138/84, HR 72, regular rhythm. JVP not elevated. Heart sounds S1+S2, no murmurs. Lungs clear to auscultation. No peripheral edema.

Ix: ECG shows normal sinus rhythm with rare premature beats. TSH, electrolytes, and Hb normal.

Doctor: It seems your heart is having these occasional extra beats, but we haven't caught an episode of an actual sustained rhythm disturbance during this visit. Given your symptoms, we need to investigate the pattern further.

Patient: That makes sense, it doesn't happen every day.

Doctor: I'm going to order a 24-hour Holter monitor to capture these events and a baseline echocardiogram to check structural integrity. My impression is that this is a benign cardiac arrhythmia of unclear origin for now. Let's see what the monitor shows before discussing if further specialist referral is needed.

Pasien wanita, 42 tahun, datang dengan keluhan kelopak mata merah, bengkak, dan sangat gatal di kedua sisi sejak 1 minggu terakhir. Pasien baru mencoba produk kosmetik baru (eyeshadow) 3 hari sebelum keluhan muncul. O/E: Edema periorbital ringan, eritema difus disertai skuama halus pada kelopak mata atas dan bawah, konjungtiva hiperemis (+). Tidak ada krusta purulen. Plan: Hentikan penggunaan kosmetik, kompres dingin, krim hidrokortison 1% pada area kelopak, tetes mata artifisial, dan cetirizine 10mg o.n. jika perlu.

Px 42M c/o petequias en MMII x 3/7. Hb 14.2 g/dL, leucos 6.4k, plaquetas 48k. Examen físico sin hepatoesplenomegalia. Dx: Trombocitopenia. Solicito frotis sangre periférica y perfil inmune; control en 1/52.

S: 38M, farmer, presented with 4-week history of fatigue, joint pains, and new onset haemoptysis. Reports daily low-grade fevers and night sweats. No history of TB, BCG status positive. 
O: Wt 62kg, BP 145/95. Lung exam: bibasal crackles. Skin: palpable purpura over lower extremities. 
Ix: Urine dipstick: 3+ blood, 2+ protein. CXR: bilateral pulmonary infiltrates. Renal function: Cr 240 umol/L. ANCA testing (c-ANCA positive). 
A: Microscopic polyangiitis; suspected pulmonary-renal syndrome.
P: Start high-dose prednisolone 60mg daily. Arrange urgent referral to Mulago for cyclophosphamide and further rheumatology management. Advise strict follow-up.

S: 62yo M, piano teacher. Complains of progressive thickening and tethering of the skin on his right palm over the last 6 months. Noted difficulty extending 4th and 5th digits. Denies trauma or recent hand infection. Mild discomfort but mainly functional impairment.

O: Firm, longitudinal cord palpable in the palmar fascia extending to the base of the 4th digit. Flexion contracture of 4th MCP joint at 20 degrees. No skin ulceration or inflammation. Sensation intact.

Ix: Clinical diagnosis confirmed.

A: Palmar fascial fibromatosis (Dupuytren's).

P: Patient advised on natural history. Hand therapy referral for splinting. Discussed surgical options vs collagenase injection for future management. Follow-up in 3 months or sooner if contracture worsens significantly.

24F, G2P1, 28 weeks gestation. Video consult. Presents with persistent burning retrosternal chest pain and 'sour' regurgitation, worse at night when lying flat to sleep. Symptoms started in early 2nd trimester and are now affecting sleep. Denies vomiting, dysphagia, or weight loss. FH: nil significant. Vitals stable: BP 110/70, HR 82, weight gain appropriate for GA. Exam: No epigastric tenderness, heart sounds clear. Assessment: Symptomatic reflux in pregnancy. Advice: Advised small frequent meals, avoiding late-night eating, and sleeping with extra pillows. Prescribed magnesium trisilicate mixture 10ml TDS p.r.n. Monitor for worsening symptoms; review at next ANC visit.

Prezada colega, encaminho o paciente A.R., 28 anos, para avaliação em seu serviço. Queixa-se de sudorese excessiva em ambas as axilas há cerca de 3 anos, de forma persistente, que não responde a antitranspirantes clínicos de alta concentração. Refere grande impacto na qualidade de vida e nas relações sociais. Ao exame, observamos manchas de suor visíveis nas roupas e maceração cutânea leve local, sem evidência de infecção fúngica secundária ou odor fétido. Nega sintomas sistêmicos, febre ou perda de peso. A glândula tireoide está impalpável e não apresenta outros sinais de disfunção autonômica. Gostaria de considerar opções de tratamento mais definitivas, como aplicação de toxina botulínica ou avaliação cirúrgica, se o quadro clínico assim permitir.

68F, presents with persistent epiphora and recurrent discharge from the medial canthus of the left eye over the past 3 months. Pt notes significant discomfort and occasional blurred vision due to crusting. O/E: Mild erythema and tenderness over the left lacrimal sac area. Expressible mucopurulent material from the inferior punctum on pressure. Conjunctiva quiet. Plan: Warm compresses, start Tobramycin/Dexamethasone drops QID. Refer to oculoplastics for irrigation and probing to assess for nasolacrimal duct obstruction. R/v in 2 weeks.

Doctor: Chào chị, hôm nay mình thấy thế nào? Tôi thấy chị mới sinh bé được 4 ngày.
Patient: Chào bác sĩ, em vẫn ổn, chỉ có điều từ lúc ra viện là em bị đau đầu kinh khủng.
Doctor: Chị đau như thế nào? Đau cả đầu hay chỉ một bên? Có kèm nhìn mờ hay nôn không?
Patient: Đau phía sau gáy rồi lan lên đỉnh đầu, mỗi khi em ngồi dậy hoặc đứng lên là đau muốn nổ tung, nằm xuống thì đỡ hơn nhiều.
Doctor: Chị có bị sốt không? Có thấy cứng cổ không?
Patient: Em không sốt, cổ cũng bình thường, chỉ là nhức quá không bế bé được.
Doctor: Lúc sinh bé chị có gây tê tủy sống phải không?
Patient: Dạ vâng, hôm đó em gây tê màng cứng để giảm đau lúc chuyển dạ.
Doctor: Tôi đã khám kỹ, không có dấu hiệu nhiễm trùng hay triệu chứng thần kinh khu trú. Dựa vào triệu chứng đau đầu tư thế sau gây tê, đây là tình trạng đau đầu do chọc dò màng cứng sau gây tê ngoài màng cứng. Chị cần nằm nghỉ tại giường, uống nhiều nước và dùng thêm Paracetamol/Caffeine theo đơn. Nếu 48 giờ tới không đỡ, chúng ta sẽ cần cân nhắc thủ thuật vá màng cứng.

Telehealth consult. 24M, asymptomatic. Patient requesting a sexual health screen following a 'high-risk' encounter over the weekend with a casual partner whose status is unknown. No dysuria, no penile discharge, no testicular pain, no systemic symptoms. O/E: Patient reports feeling well. I have arranged for a self-collected urine NAAT for Chlamydia/Gonorrhoea, plus bloods for HIV and Syphilis serology at the local clinic. Advised on barrier protection and instructed to abstain from sexual contact until results are returned. Follow-up via patient access portal in 1 week. Safety-netted re: symptoms.

42-jähriger Patient, männlich, Bauarbeiter. Sturz von Leiter am Morgen. Schmerzen im linken Knie/Unterschenkel massiv. Vitals: BP 130/85, HR 92, SpO2 98%. O/E: Bein deutlich geschwollen, Fehlstellung im Bereich des distalen Femurs sichtbar, keine offene Wunde, Pulse distal tastbar, Sensibilität intakt. Keine Kopfverletzungen. Plan: Schmerzmittel (Paracetamol/Tramadol) gegeben, Schiene angelegt. Transport zum Distrikt-Krankenhaus für Röntgen und weitere Versorgung eingeleitet.

Doctor: Buen día, pase. ¿Qué lo trae por la clínica hoy?
Paciente: Doctor, traigo las uñas de las manos muy feas, se ven como blancas y blandas en la base, y me duele un poco el dedo índice.
Doctor: Déjeme ver. Sí, veo una inflamación en el pliegue ungueal con algo de secreción blanquecina.
Paciente: ¿Es por el trabajo? Paso mucho tiempo con los guantes y las manos húmedas limpiando el área de la cocina.
Doctor: Es muy probable. La humedad constante favorece este tipo de infección micótica.
Paciente: ¿Necesito algún antibiótico?
Doctor: No, esto es un hongo, no una bacteria. Necesita antifúngicos.
Paciente: ¿Es contagioso?
Doctor: No mucho, pero debe mantenerlas secas.
Doctor: Imp: Candidosis de la uña / paroniquia. Plan: Clotrimazol crema 1% aplicar cada 12h, evitar contacto prolongado con agua, usar guantes de algodón bajo los de goma. Seguimiento en 2 semanas.

42yo male, telehealth follow-up. Pt reports persistent sensation of a 'lump' or 'tight band' in the throat that has been present for the last 6 weeks.
